dpal ldan rgyud stod grwa tshang zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnams grangs mang ra sa gtsug lag khang nas rje 'bum sgang brgyud byang ngos su spyi le gcig tsam song na ra mo che grong dbus su gtsug lag khang 'di mjal rgyu yod/ ra mo che zhes pa ni/rgya bzas shākya mu ne'i sku brnyan la dar gyi ra ba bskongs pas ra mo che zhes dang /yang sa der sbra gur chen po phubs pas sbra mo che zhes pa rim bzhin ra mo che zhes par sgra 'gyur tshul/ rgya stag ra mo che ni/ rgya yi stag nam mkhar 'phyo ba lta bu yod pas rgya stag ces dang / yang rgya bza'i phyag rjes ka bar gsal bas rgya rtags zhes pa rim bzhin rgya stag ces par sgra 'gyur tshul/ rgya btab ra mo che ni rgya bzas btab ba'i lha khang yin pas rgya btab ces sogs gsung srol mi 'dra ba so sor yod/ de'ang rgya'i btsun mo kun shin kong jo'i rten skal du gdan drangs pa'i rdzo bo shākya mu ne(jo bo'i lo rgyus 'byung ba ra sa gtsug lag khang gi gnas bshad du gsal)shing rtar drangs te gnas der phebs skabs bye thang du byings nas ma 'drong ba'i tshe/ rgya bzas phyogs bzhir ka ba bzhi btsugs/ dar dkar gyi yol bas dres te mchod pa phul/ de nas spor thang gi gab rtse bting nas brtsigs pas rwa mo che'i sa de klu'i pho brang du yin pa shes/der shākya mu ne'i sku brnyan bzhugs su gsol na klu'i gnod pa non par mkhyen te rgya yi bzo bo mkhas pa rnams la gtsug lag khang gi rmang 'ding bcug pas/ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang dang dus mnyam par gtsug lag khang de'ang 'grub par mdzad/ rgya yi yab rje mnyes par yong ched lha khang gi sgo'ang shar rgya nag tu gtad/ skor lam phyi nang gnyis las nang ma'i gtsang khang sbrug mar jo bo shākya mu ne+e nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs su gsol/ de nas chos rgyalasrong btsan sku gshegs rjes kyi mang srong mang btsan gyi dus su rgya dmag lhag nyer shākya mu rna'i sku brnyan ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang gi lho sgo me long can du gdan drangs/ mi bskyod do rje'i sku brnyan yang shākya mu rna'i sku
brnyan yin par rloms te 'o rgyal thang bar gdan drangs/ de nas mi theg pas der bskyur tshul sogs ra sa gtsug lag khang gi gnas bshad du gsal ba bzhin dang / de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gi yum gyim shing ko jos ra sa gtsug lag khang gi lho sgo me long can nas bzhes te ra sa gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyan yang chos lung nas gdan drangs te rgya btab ra mo che gtsug lag khang du bzhugs su gsol bas sku brnyan de gnyis kyi bzhugs gnas brje 'grul byung tshul de ltar yin zhes gsungs/'on kyang sku brnyan 'di gnyis kyi sku rgyu gcig yin la/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi rab gnas mdzad pa gcig pa yin pas byin rlabs la dbye ba med ces gsungs/ de rjes tshal ba khri dpon dga' ldan dpal gyis dge 'dun bzhi grwa gcig gtsugs gnang bas bzhi sde zhes su grags/ de rjes rgyud chen kun dga' don grub kyis mkhas grub shes rab seng ge dang / rgyud chen sbyin pa dpal gnyis kyi rnam thar ma nyams pa bzung nas 'dul khrims gtsang zhing rgyud kyi 'chad nyan lo bcu gsum bar mdzad de rgyud smad du bzhugs pa'i skabs sde dpon zhig sar zhabs brtan yag po ma gnang ba zhes pa'i rkyen byas rgyud smad kyi sgrig las phud pas chums mda' bar phebs te der bzhugs skabs su/ grwa rgyun so gnyis der phebs pa dang mjal bas khyed rnams gang du phebs sam zhes gsungs par/ nga tsho rgyud stod du slob gnyer la 'gro ba yin gsungs pas thog mar rgyud stod gtsang du yod pa la/ dbus su'ang rgyud stod grwa tshang zhig 'debs pa'i rten 'brel dang / grwa rgyun so gnyis yod pas gsang 'dus lha so gnyis kyi rten 'brel 'grigs te thog mar byams pa gling zhes par rgyud stod grwa tshang phyag btab/ de rjes 1474lor lha sa skyid chu shin tu rgyas te lha sa chus 'jigs la nye ba'i tshe rgyud chen kun dga' don grub kyis phyag g.yog gcig la drug cu ma dang gcig la gzhis bdag gi gtor ma 'khyer bcug nas
shin tu rgyas pa'i skyid chu'i steng bting nas de steng byon/ phyag g.yog gnyis la mig ma gdang zhes gsungs par/ gzhis bdag gi gtor ma 'khyer ba'i phyag g.yog gis mig blta skabs skyid chu rab tu rgyas pa'i 'jigs skrag mthong ste chu la 'khur/ de nas bzung rgyud stod kyi drug cu ma bskyon skabs gzhis bdag gi gtor ma med pa'i srog de nas dar/ 'on kyang skyid chu zhi bar mdzad stabs de'i bdag rkyen du rgya btab ra mo che gnang bas de nas bzung rgyud stod pa ra mo che ru chags/ de nas rim bzhin rgya skyed byung ste gtsug lag khang thog brtsegs gsum/ bar thog tu sman bla khang rten/ gtso jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang / mgon thang gsum/ nang sgo gnyis kyi bar du shing se ba'i sdong po la srog shing byas te bzhengs pa'i mgon po se sdong ma ste mgon po gri gug sgo 'phyor du 'jim gyi rgyal chen rigs bzhi bzo bkod legs pa/ yang thog tu gser zangs kyi rgya phibs bcas yod/ sngon dge 'dun grangs700tsam gyis dpal gsang ba 'dus pa gtso bor gyur ba'i bde gsang 'jigs gsum phyag len gnang ba yin/da lta phyi dbyibs sngon gyi de rang nyams gso gnang ba'i nang rten gtso jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyan la 1966lor gtor skyon byung ste sku stod sku smad gnyis su bzos/ sku'i gzungs su phul ba'i rin chen btso thal gyis de khul gyi sa gzhi'ang nag por btang / sku smad lha sku chag dum dang mnyam du bod tu lus kyang sku stod pe cing gi bzo grwa zhig la dbor/ de rjes ra sa gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che nyams gso zhu 'go tshugs rjes/ ra mo che jo bo'i sku smad las sku stod ma rnyed stabs sku stod gsar bzhengs zhus te bzhugs su gsol/ de rjes kun gzigs paṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa'i thugs khur gzigs bskyang 'og jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku stod 'khrul bral pe cing nye 'dabs kyi bzo grwa zhig nas btsal brnyed byung ste lha sar gdan drangs te sku'i stod smad lhan du
'dzoms pa byung ste da lta mjal rgyu yod pa 'di nyid lags/ gzhan yang sngon gyi sku brnyan so so'i sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / ldebs ris rnying ma sogs mjal rgyu yod/ —che dpag lha khang / tshe dpag lha khang ni/ rwa mo che gtsug lag khang gi lho ngos su mjal rgyu yod/ lha khang de ni rwa che gtsug lag khang bzhengs bsgrubs rjes sa lhag gis lha khang de bzhengs gnang ba zhes dang / rjes su bzhi sde dgon gyis bdag skyong gnang ba yin/ lha khang de'i nang rten gtso bo tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan thog so gcig lhag yod pa de'i gzungs su a ru rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa bzhugs su gsol bas dus rgyun zhal mdangs 'gyur ba dang / der skor ba bsag na nad rigs kun las zhi zhes pa'i gsung srol yod/ gzhan yang sku de'i gzungs su chos rgyal nor bzang gi khyab kyang yod gsungs/ yang lha khang de'i nub tu rgya'i lha zhes pa'i mdun du khra'u cha'an (73sbyo)zhes smyug ma bkrug ste mo 'debs sa yod/da lta sngon gyi lha khang nyams gso dang / rgya skyed gnang ba'i nang sngon gyi tshe dpag med kyi sku brnyan gyis gtsos sku brnyan mang po gsar bzhengs gnang ba 'jal rgyu yod/rje 'bum sgang lha khang / rje 'bum sgang lha khang ni/ ra sa gtsug lag khang nas rwa mo cher 'gro sa'i lam gyi shar ngos rgyud smad grwa tshang gi nub ngos su lha khang 'di mjal rgyu yod/ lha khang 'di ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa ste rgyal ba lnga pa'i dus phyag btab gnang mdzad/ sngon rnam rgyal grwa tshangagis 'dzin skyong gnang ba yin/ sngon lha khang 'di'i rten gtso ni rje tsong
kha pa'i sku brnyan dang de'i mtha' 'khor du sku rgyu rdza las grub ba'i rje tshe 'dzin ma'i sku brnyan mkhyid gang tsam 'bum ther gcig yod pas rje 'bum sgang lha khang zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / gzhan yang lha khang 'di'i dbyibs ni blos blangs dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs can phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi dang bcas par rten dang brten par bcas bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta sngon gyi lha khang la nyams gso gnang ba'i nang rje yab sras gsum kyi sku brnyan sogs sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/rgyud smad pa/ mtshan rgyas par dpal gsang chen rgyud smad grwa tshang ngam/ rgyud smad lcang lo can zhes zhu/ rwa che gtsug lag khang ngam/ rgyud stod grwa tshang nas spyi le gcig tsam shar ngos su phebs na rme ru dgon gyi nub ngos su grwa tshang de mjal rgyu yod/ grwa tshang de ni gsang chen rgyud grwa rnam gnyis kyi ya rgyal yin/ grwa tshang de phyag 'debs pa po ni/ rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob mkhas grub shes rab seng ges spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i dus 'gor phyag btab gnang mdzad/ de'ang rje tsong kha pas/ se ra chos sdings su〈'grel pa bzhi sbrags〉kyi phyag dpe phyag tu bzhes te khyed cag mkhas pa rnams kyi khrod na dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad srol 'dzin nus pa su yod dam zhes gsungs par/ der tshogs kun gyis cang zhu mi nus par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje shes rab seng ge yar bzhengs te sku phyag lan gsum phul te/ de lta bu bdag gis bgyi'o/ zhes zhus pas rje tsong kha pa thugs shin tu dgyes te gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku brnyan byin can dang 〈'brel pa bzhi sbrags〉nang mchod ka pā la gang ba sogs gnang ste gsang chen sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ de nas je nyid thog mar gtsang phyogs seng ge rtse hril rgyud ces par
phebs te 'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang por rgyud kyi 'chad nyan bgyis dgos pa'i zhal ta mdzad/ de nas srad rin chen rtse pas sbyin bdag mdzad nas/ srad dga' ldan pho zang du mkhas pa mang po la rgyud 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa 'chad nyan mdzad pas stod rgyud par grags pa'am srad rgyud par grags pa'i sngags grwa phun sum tshogs pa phyag btab/ de nas spyi lo 1433lor mkhas grub rjes dbus su rgyud cig 'dzugs dgos pa'i zhal ta mdzad pa bzhin rje shes rab seng ges dbus gtsang brgyud nas rang nyid kyi bu slob mang du bsdus nas lo der lha sar rgyud kyi 'chad nyan btsugs/ rje nyid kyis grwa tshang 'di nyid lo bcu gsum gyi bar du bskyangs gnang mdzad/ de nas slobadapon sbyin pa dpal la gtad gnang ba bcas yin/ sngon grwa tshang der khang tshan lnga yod pa ni a mdo khang tshan dang / tsha ba khang tshan/ rgyal rong khang tshan/ ser kong khang tshan/ spre'u khang tshan bcas lnga yin/ thog mar sa de rdo ring paṇ+ḍi ta'i bzhugs gnas lcang lo can zhes pa yin stabs rgyud smad lcang lo can zhu don yang de ltar yin/ de'ang 'du khang ka ring bzhi/ ka thung zhe brgyad nang rten gtso gong gsal rje tsong kha pas gnang ba'i gsang 'dus kyi gser sku dang / rje nyid kyi shog ka li/ gtsang khang spug mar dge bshes bsam grub rin po ches mthun rkyen gnang ste bzhengs gnang ba'i rje tsong kha pa'i 'jim gyi sku brnyan thog so nyis thog gtsos rten dang brten par bcas dang / dge 'dun zhal grangs 556gis gtso bo gsang bde 'jigs gsum phyag bzhed dang / gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud blo 'dzin gyis rgyug sprod gnang dgos pa/ gzhan yang phyi gsang sngags kyi grwa tshang la nang 'dul ba'i grwa tshang zhes66bzang mthar lhung mi chog ces g.yag sde grwa tshang yang zhu zhing gtsang g.yag sde'i ther ma spus zhan gyis bzos pa'i stod 'gag thog mar dmar rkyang nas rjes su 'gag dmar ser can bzhes srol de dar/ lo ltar chos thog ces rgyud

bcas la rten dang brten par bcas bzhugs su gsol yod/ sngon dge 'dun bdun bcu don lngas ri bo dge ldan kyi gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyis gtsos sngags chog khag phyag bzhed mdzad pa yin/ ser smad grwa tshang gi khongs yin/da lta thog so nyis thog nyams gso zhus pa'i nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / ldebs ris rnying ma mang po bzhugs pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/bragalha klu sgrag mtshan rgyas par brag lha bkra shis gzhal yas khang zhes zhu/ lcags po ri'i shar ngos su pho brang po ta lar zhal phyogs pa/ pho brang po ta la nas spyi khre nyis brgya tsam gyi sa na brag lha klu sgug lha khang de mjal rgyu yod/ lha khang de ni chos rgyal srong btsan gyis mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs skabs sam/ ra sa gtsug lag khang bzhengs bsgrubs rjes su lha khang de bskrun pa yin/ de'ang thog mar gnas der brag phug cig yod pa la der gtso bo thub pa brag lha mgon po dang / de'i g.yas na shā ri'i bu/ g.yon na mong gal gyi bu/ de'i g.yas na rgyal ba byams pa/g.yonacan spyan ras gzigs bcas brag la gsal bar rang byon du yod pa la/de nas chos rgyal gyis ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams gsog pa'i phyir du bal po'i lha bzos 'bur du brkos te brag la skor khang brko bar mdzad pa la tshwa gong che ba'i skabs su brag bre gang brkos par tshwa bre re gnang ba bcas kyis skor khang yang 'grub/ brag lha zhes pa ni de ltar dang / klu sgug ces pa ni/ma 'ongs par ra sa gtsug lag khang gi jo bo shākya mu ne 'og phyogs klu yul du gdan 'dren pas de'i skabs su sems can gyi bsod nams gsog phyir thub pa brag lha mgon po 'di nyid mi yul du bzhugs pa yin zhes zer/ gzhan

rjes rim bzhin rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pa dang / sde srid bsod nams rab brtan/sde srid blo bzang mthu stobs/ lha bzang / pho lha mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal/ rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa bcas bar rim bzhin rgya skyed mdzad de da lta'i 'bras spungs dgon gyi gzhi khyon 'di nyid byung / da lta'i tshogs chen 'du khang ka thung 159dang ka ring 24can rgyas bskrun gnang ba'i 'dugang nub gral gyi gtsang khang sbrug mar sman 'dam gyi dus gsum sangs rgyas thog so nyis thog la 'khor nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba/ 'du khang gdong gral gyi dbu la sku rgyu sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku brnyan mi tshad lhag dang / de'i g.yas su gser zangs gyi byams pa chos 'khor thog so gnyis tsam g.yon du rje khams gsum gzil gnon/ 'du khang shar gral gyi gtsang khang sdug mar sku rgyu sman 'dam las grub pa'i mi dbang byams pa thog so nyis thog sprul sku'i cha byad can dang / 'du khang nub ngos lha mo khang nangadapal ldan lha mo/ bar thog tu rgyal ba sku phreng gnyis pa dang bzhi pa'i dngul gdung dang / klu 'bum mchod rten zhes pa gnyis/ mi dbang lha khang nang mi dbang byams pa'i zhal ras mjal ba dang / sne'u dpon mo a 'dzoms kyi gdong shel/ gzhan yang bla sku khag bka'i 'gyur lha khang nang gser bris kyi bka' 'gyur la tsan+da gyi glegs shing / gdong ba so la rgyan spros dang ldan pa 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag ces pa/ gsum thog 'khrungs rabs lha khang nang dbus su rgyal ba lnga pa dang chos rgyal rnam pa'i sku brnyan/ byams pa mthong sgrol lha khang nang sku rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog so gnyis ldan/ de'i mdun du rje tsong kha pas 'jam dbyangs chos rjer gnang ba'i gter dung / de'i zhogs kyi jo bo lha khang nang dbus su jo bo rin po che dngul sku srid zhi'i 'jigs skyob zhes mi tshad ma dang dngul gyi bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad/ gnas bcu lha khang nang byang chub shing las grub pa'i thub
pa gtso 'khor dang / tsan dan dkar po las grub pa'i gnas brtan bcu drugyang steng du gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gnyis dang / gser zangs kyi gañjir rgyal mtshan sogs dang ldan/ thog mar tshogs chen gcig dang grwa tshang bdun yod pa las rjes su blo gsal gling grwa tshang dang sgo mang grwa tshang / sngags pa grwa tshang / bde yangs grwa tshang bcas grwa tshang bzhi ru bsdus/ blo gsal gling grwa tshang 'du khang ka ba 120la ka ring 12can gyi gtsang khang spug mar rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan dang / 'du khang nang 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i sku brnyan sogs rten dang brten par bcas dang / 'di khongs khang tshan nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa ni/ tsha ba khang tshan dang / kong po/ phu khang / rong po/ lho pa/ mi nyag spom 'bor/ ṭe byor/ nyag te/ rgya/ tshul khang / gtsang pa/ rtsed thang / dpe thub/ go bo/ pha ra/ nyang po/ gling / ldan ma/ gu ge rgyal rong / rgyal pa/ dbu stod bcas dang da dung tsha ba khang tshan khongs kyi mi tshan mtsho smad mi tshan dang / sding kha mi tshan/ gnyer pa mi tshan bcas dang spyi yongs kyi mi tshan bod pa gzhung mi tshan sogs yod/ sgo mang grwa tshang gi 'du khang blo gsal gling dang rgya khyon snyom pa la gtsang khang spug mar rgyal ba mi 'khrug pa'i sku brnyan rdul mi bzhes pa zhes pa dang / 'du khang nang rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan dang / rgyal po lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs/rje zhabs snyun ma sogs gsung byon mas gtsos rten dang brten par bcas dang / 'di'i khongs har gdong khang tshan/ bsam blo/ gung ru/ bra ste/ klu 'bum/ rta dbon/ gzhung pa/ mnga' ris/ zung chu/ grwa nyi/ 'chad pa/bya bral/ 'da' shing / ri tsa/ chu bzang / the bo bcas khang tshan bcu drug la khar kha mi tshan/ bi do/ thag ring / lcang skya/ gu lung / lam pa bcas bsam blo khang tshan gyi khongs dang / nyan po mi tshan/ bru byus/ wa shul/ hor/mtsho khag thor bgos bcas har gdong khang tshan gyi khongs/ bod pa gzhung mi
tshan dang / dga' gdong mi tshan ni spyi yongs kyi mi tshan bcas yin/ sngags pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang ka ba 48la ka ring brgyad kyi gtsang khang spug mar rwa lo tsa'i sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sku brnyan dang / ya ma ra dz+ra'i 'khor chen/ bde yangs grwa tshang 'du khang ka ba 64ga ka ring bzhi'i gtsang khang spug mar rgyal ba byams pa mgon po dang / yang thog srung ma khang nang 'phrin las rgyal po sogs 'bras spungs kyi lha srung rnams bzhugs su gsol yod/ gzhan yang 'bras spungs pho zang ni thog mar phag gru'i pho brang yin pa la rgyal ba sku phreng gnyis par phul/ de rjes gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis gtsang pa rgyal po kurma bstan skyong dbang po'i srid dbang gtor te bod yongs kyi srid dbang rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga par phul ba nas bzung gzhung sa dga' ldan pho zang zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ sngon dge 'dun zhal grangs chig khrir nye bas gtso bo gzhung chen ka pod lnga slob gnyer gnang ba la sngags pa grwa tshang gis dge ldan lugs kyi sngags kyi cho ga phyag len gnang ba yin/ dgon der 'bras spungs zho ston zhes lo ltar bod zla 6tshes 30nyin dbyar gnas zhal bzhes bsgrubs te grwa dmangs la zho'i bsnyen bkur zhu ba dang / gos sku bkrams te de'i mdun a lce lha mo 'khrab ston byed pa yin/ de rjes rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dus 'bras spungs zho ston tshar ba dang mu mthud nor gling du'ang lha mo 'khrab ston bzhes pas nor gling zho ston zhes pa'ang de ltar byung / yang bod zla 1tshes 8nyin 'bras spungs sku 'bum zhes klu 'bum mchod rten khang du chos mjal gtong srol yod/ klu 'bum zhes pa ni/sngon dus tshod de'i nyin rje tsong kha pa tshogs phebs gnang ba dang / mkhas grub rje dang 'jam dbyangs chos rje tshogs langs chos rtsod mdzad pas/skabs der klu 'bum khang nas klu 'bum gcig gis chos mjal zhus pa kun gyis mthong bas rjes su der klu 'bum mchod rten gnyis bzhengs pa dang /
'bras spungs klu 'bum zhes pa'ang de ltar byung / da dung klu 'bum lha khang nang rgyal ba sku phreng gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa bcas kyi gdung rten yod/da lta bde yangs grwa tshang gi rten gsum gsar bzhengs gnang ba las gzhan tshogs chen gcig dang grwa tshang gsum gyi rten sngon gyi de rang mjal rgyu yod la/khang tshan khag cig nyams gso gnang ba'i nang sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de'i rgyab rir rma ri rabs 'byams bstan skyong rdo je grags rgyal ma'i bla ri dge 'phel ri zhes pa der sku mtshams su bzhugs mkhan la dge ba rab tu 'phel zhes zer/ dgon de'i shar nub so so nas bab rgyun re babs yong ba yin pas shar chu babs sa'i ri ldebs su dpe mtshams bzhugs sa'i mtshams khang mang po yod/ dge 'phel ri khrod ni rgyab ri'i sked pa'i mtshams su yod/ thog mar gnas der paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal bzhugs pa dang / de rjes rgyal ba lnga pa/ sgrub thob dpa' bo rdo rje/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che/ dka' chen ye shes rgyal mtshan sogs kyi sgrub khang yod/de rjes rgyal ba sku phreng bdun pa'i dus dge slong zhal grangs drug cu re lnga bar gtan 'bebs gnang / rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon gnas der phebs dgos pa yin stabs rgyal ba'i gzims chung dang sgrub khang khag la rten dang brten par bcas bzhugs su gsol/ gzhan yang ri de'i rtsa chu bzang zhing ltag tu rtswa klu bdud rdo rje dang / chu 'gro ba 'dren pa sogs yod pas ri de'i ldebs kyi bzhon ma'i 'o ma bcud che zhes mthong chen po byed/da lta gnas der yang nyams gso gang 'tshams gnang yod/gnas chung grwa tshang / mtshan rgyas par dbang grags rol pa'i dga' tshal gnas chung rdo rje sgra dbyangs gling ngam/ gnas chung g.yu lo bkod sogs zhu/ 'bras spungs dgon nas mar yong dus g.yon ngos su dgon de
chags yod/ gnas chung zhes pa ni/ lo tsā ba be+e ro tsā na gnas der phebs skabs sgro sdong gcig nas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i skor gu ru rin po cher zhus pas/gu rus ma 'ongs pa na gnas der dgon pa zhig chags yong / sgro sdong de ni pe har gyi bla shing yin/ de'i 'gram gyi mtshe'u de pe har gyi bla mtsho yin zhes gsungs pa dang / de rjes lha sras mu ne btsan pos der dgon zhig btab/dge 'dun bzhi grwa gcig gi sde btsugs/ sba dpal dbyangs mkhan por bskos/ bsam yas nas sgrol ma'i sku brnyan zhig gdan drangs te bzhugs su gsol bas gnas chung g.yu lo bkod ces pa de ltar byung / bsam yas gnas che ba dang / der gnas chung ba yin pas gnas chung zhes pa de ltar byung gsung / yang gsung srol gzhan zhig la/ thog mar gnas chung chos skyong gung thang du gnas yod pa la/ gung thang bla ma zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'am/mtshal pa byams pa kun dgas gser khang dgon pa nas pe har gyi rten sgam chung la bskur bas 'bras spungs kyi mdun du 'khar/ skabs der 'bras spungs bde yangs grwa tshang gi mkhan po lcog pa byang chub dpal ldan gyis mkhyen te gsol dpon la de ring ma ki'i chu khar dngos po zhig yod pas khyod kyis de kha ma phyes par 'khyer shog ces gsungs/ gsol dpon gyis de ltar chu khar song bas der sgam zhig 'khar nas yod pa de 'khyer 'ong / da lta'i gnas chung gi ltag tu 'byor skabs sgam ji ljid du song bas/ gsol dpon ya mtshan te kha phyes pas de'i nang gzhan gang yang med par bya phug ron zhig thon te sgro sdong steng du 'phur bas/ gsol dpon de mar mkhan po'i bka' slob dran te66bla ma mkhyen zhes gsungs shor bas pha bong der/ bla ma mkhyen/ zhes pa'i rang byon 'khrungs pa da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ de nas gsol dpon mkhan po'i sku mdun du song nas gong gsal gyi gnas lugs rnams zhus pas/mkhan pos a kha/ srung ma de 'bras spungs dgon nang gnas na shin tu legs
kyang da gnas sa chung song zhes gsungs pas/ gnas chung zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rta mgo g.yu khra can zhes lcog pa byang chub dpal ldan gyi chibs pa rlung shugs can shi ba'i mgo g.yang la gser zho stong re ba'i g.yu khra brgyan te/ pe har rten mdos 'di la bcol/ zhes gsungs pas rta mgo g.yu khra can/ zhes pa de ltar byung zhes gsung srol sna tshogs yod/thog mar g.yu lo bkod dang sgro sdong lha khang zhes pa yod pa la/ da lta'i gnas chung dgon ni spyi lo 1681lor sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos btab gnang mdzad pa dang / dge 'dun zhal grangs 101'dzugs gnang gis sa dge rnying gsum phyag bzhed mdzad pa yin/ gnas chung chos skyong ngam byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po'i bka' yi blon po rdo rje grags ldan/ pe har rgyal po sogs mtshan mi 'dra ba tsam las don du ngo bo gcig yin/ de'ang thog mar 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gnyis ka sne'ur bzhugs skabs nub gcig mnal lam du dan bag brgyud chos sde 'debs dgongs su phebs snang la lha gnam thel dkar po yin zer ba zhig gis/ khyed kyis 'dir chos sde zhig thobs dang / ngas khyed la btsun pa stong khrag gcig 'bul/ zer ba zhig byung ba ltar na 'bras spungs dgon thog mar 'debs dus nas gnas chung chos skyong ni dgon de'i srung ma yin par mngon/ de ltar chos skyong 'di ni gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi srung ma dmar nag gnyis las dmar po gnas chung chos skyong dang / nag po dpal ldan lha mo yin/ srung ma 'di gnyis dga' ldan phong brang gi brten dgos pa ni/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos dpal ldan lha mo brten gnang ma dzad pa dang / de rjes rgyal ba lnga pa'i dus dga' ldan pho brang thog mar 'bras spungs su chags shing de rjes dga' ldan pho brang rtse po ta lar spos gnang yang srung ma dmar nag gnyis brten pa'i lo rgyus de ltar byung / gnas chung chos skyong ni sku khog ser mo ba zhig la sku
phebs gnang zhing / gzhung sa mchog gi gal gnad che ba'i don chen dang /rgyalab sku phreng rim byon gyi yang srid btsad gcod byed pa sogs gnas chung chosaskyong gi bka' lung ji phebs la brtags pa byed srol yod stabs sku khog la'ang ta bla ma zhes dgon nang gi dbu gnas mtho shos yin pas ma tshad gzhung sa dang 'bras spungs sogs la'ang dbu gnas mthon po yod/ sngon 'du khang ka ba bcu drug gi gtsang khang dbus nang gser zangs kyi jo bo mi tshad la/de'igayas su rgya dngul las grub pa'i rgyal ba skal bzang rgya mtsho mi tshad ma/jo bo'i g.yon du 'jim pa las grub pa'i rje tsong kha pa mi tshad la/ rgya dngul las grub pa'i gu ru snang srid gzil gnon mi tshad ma'i pad zhwa'i ngos su pha lam gyi khra rgyan gser bkyag dang bcas pa/ de'i g.yas su rgya dngul las grub pa'i rgyal ba lnga pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad ma/ jo bo'i g.yon du gser zangs gyi sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan mi tshad ma/ shar nas nub tu gzigs pa rgyal po byas ba cas zhes sku lnga gcig bsdus kyi rnam pa yin pa'i sku'i sgrom la zhal 'bag bsgron pa/ de'i g.yon du sku lnga dang 'jigs byed sogs kyi lo gtor bcas dang / ldebs ris su rje tsong kha pa yab sras dang / 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun rgyud/ rgyal ba lnga pa sogs sku phreng na rim/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad/ sku lnga yab yum blon po dang bcas pa/ sku rten blo bzang legs 'byor la gnas chung sku phebs kyi sku brnyan dang / 'bras srungs su mdzad chen gnang tshul/ sku rten shākya yar 'phel la gnas chung thog phebs kyis dbu la ras dkar dkris pa bcas sogs kyi ldebs ris spus legs dang gtsang khang dbus ma ka bzhi'i nang gtso bo chos skyong sku phebs gnang sa dang /mtha' 'khor du rgyal po sku lnga dang rta mgrin sogs kyi sku brnyan/ rdo rje grags ldan mi tshad can gyi thugs dkar seng 'bag smug chung zhes pa dam 'byar ma rgyal ba sku phreng rim byon gyis rab gnas gnang ba/ sgro sdong lha khang ka bzhi'i
nang rgyal po pe har thog mar chags pa'i sgro sdong thog so gsum ldan dang / rdo rje grags ldan gyi gtsang khang g.yon 'dod khams lha khang ka bzhi'i nang rten mdos dang / 'dzugs gtor sogs bzhugs pa bcas dang / nyis thog tshoms chen dang gsum thog gzim chung dang bcas par rten dang brten pa/yang steng du gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang bcas pa yod/da lta sngon gyi 'du khang thog bsangs bskyon pa'i nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gu ru snang srid gzig gnon thog so gsum ldan/ sngon pe har gnas pa'i sgro sdong gi rtsa ba/ lhag tu 'du khang dang rwa sgor nang ldebs ris rnying ma mang po sogs mjal rgyu yod/dgon der gnas chung sprel zla zhes lo 'khor bcu gnyis kyi sprel lor brtan ma dang gnas chung chos skyong dga' gdong chos skyong bcas dbu bzhugs thog nye 'khor gyi lha babs rgyu yod pa rnams dngos yin min lha bsdur brgyabs te lha ngo ma min na 'di nyin phebs mi thub ces zer/lha lung ri khrod/ lha lung ri khrod ni/ gnas chung dgon nas spyi le gsum tsam 'khor lam brgyud song na gnas chung ri brgyud kyi shar ngos su ri khrod de mjal rgyu yod/ da lta lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje bzhugs myong ba'i sgrub phug tsam las ri khrod nyams gso zhu thub med kyang / ri khrod de'i nye 'dabs su sa phung sgang zhes pa'i grong tsho zhig yod pa de la sngon ming gling bu thang zhes zer/ gling bu thang zer don ni/ sngon bod kyi rgyal rabs mjug ma glang dar gyi dbu la rwa co yod pas de 'geb ched du dbu skra lhas ma brgyabs te 'gebs parabyed/ gang yin zhe na rgyal por dbu rwa yod pa gzhan gyis shes na rgyal po'i sku tsher bar chad yod ces ma 'ongs lung bstan yod/ der brten dbu skra

btab gnang mdzad/ thog mar bzhugs gnas gtan 'jags med par tshal gung thang dang / dbus stod sogs su chos thog tu phebs pas byes grwa tshang zhes par grags/ de'ang kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen seng ge ni/ la stod byang gi yul du gsang sngags rnying ma'i grub thob kyi rgyud du 'khrungs/ dbus su phebs nas rje tsong kha pa dang / dge 'dun grub pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos je sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs/ 'bras spungs zur khang du bzhugs nas gsan bsam mdzad skabs su 'gran zlar 'dug pa 'ga' yis thugs bsun nas 'khor mang po dang bcas 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i bstod pa gsung bzhin se rar phebs/ de nas mkhan thog kha shas song rjes 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyis grwa tshang 'di'i mkhan po gnang skabs se rar gtan 'jags su bzhugs pas grwa tshang 'di chags/ 'du khang ka ring 8la ka thung 92kyi dbus su rwa sgreng sku phreng lnga pa dang / khri chen ngag dbang chos ldan/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ rje blo bzang rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin blo bzang don grub/ 'dod yon dngul gdung sogs sku brnyan khag dang / nub kyi gtsang khang nang dus gsum sangs rgyas rgyas kyi sku brnyan dang 'brel ba'i nye sras brgyad dang de 'brel rta mgrin khang yod/ de'ang grwa tshang 'di ma chags gong da lta'i rta mgrin khang gi shul du dur khrod yin pa dang / kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen zhabs skor du phebs rim bzhin der skyes pa'i shing se ba'i sdong po zhig la rtag tu na bza' 'thog pa ltar du byed/ nyin zhig bya dmar po zhig se phung la 'thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas zhib par gzigs dus se phung de'i dkyil nas rta mgrin yang gsang mjal te rta skad kyang sgrog pas de mar chos gos phud nas shing de la dkris te yang gsang gi sku brnyan bzhengs gnang ba da lta'ang mjal rgyuyod pa 'di nyid lags/ 'di ni shin tu nas gyin rlabs che zhing grwa tshang 'dir legs nyes dus 'gyur sogs kyi snga ltas su rta skad sa'i gting nas sgrog
pa yang yang byung zhes grags pa'i sku brnyan gyis dbus mtha' 'khor du srung ma khag bzhugs su gsol yod/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen blo gros rin chen gzhis ka dpal 'byor lhun por bzhugs skabs yab rtogs ldan yon tan mgon por84khyod yi dam 'di dang phur pa 'di ma bral ba bgyis shig ces rta mgrin gyi chos skor dang / phur pa ched du skyel mi byung / phur pa de ni grub thob 'dar 'phyar gyi gter ma byin can yin stabs lo ltar bod zla 12tshes27nyin se ra phur mjal zhes mjal kha gtong srol yod pa'i phur pa de'ang mgon khang der bzhugs/ gdong gral dkyil gyi gtsang khang dbus su rje tsong kha pa dang /g.yas su ston pa bcom ldan 'das/ g.yon du 'od dpag med/ gdong gral g.yas kyi gtsang khang nang rgyal ba byams pa dang / jo bo shākya mu rna/ de'i g.yon gyi gtsang khang nang 'jam dbyangs chos 'khor dang / byams pa chos 'khor sogs bzhugs su gsol yod pa/ yang thog rta mgrin lha khang nang gtso bo rta mgrin yang gsang dang / gu ru rin po che/ rgyal ba lnga pa sogs dang /shar gyi lha khang nang thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong sogs bzhugs/gzhan yang grwa tshang de khongs khang tshan nyer gcig yod pa ni/ 1har gdong khang tshan/ khubasam blo khang tshan/ 3bya bral/ 〈kre bo/ 5bra ti/ 6tsha ba/7nyo pa/ 8sgom sde/ 9la ba/ 10'dan ma11zangs dkar/ 12gu ge13dpe thub/ 14stag mo/15gtsang pa/ 16rgyal byed/ 17ye pa/18gnyal pa/19dwags po/ 20rtsed thang / 21spom 'bor bcas yin/grwa tshang smad thos bsam nor bu'i gling ni/ kun mkhyen byang chub 'bum pas phyag btab gnang mdzad/ 'du khang ka ring 12dang ka thung 88kyi gtsang khang dbus su jo bo shākya mu ne thog so gnyis tsam dang / g.yas su byams pa/g.yon du 'jam dbyangs/ rje yab sras gsum/ rje pha bong kha/ tshe smon gling rgyal thog skabs phul ba'i jo bo byang chub chen po sogs dang / gtsang khang
nub tu sne'u chung pa'i phyag bzo 'jigs byed dang / tha 'go/ nag po skor gsum sogs dang / gtsang khang dkyil du mi dbang jo bo gtso bor gyur ba'i nyezas brgyad/ gtsang khang shar du rje tsong kha pa dang / 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad/ jo rngog 'brom gsum bcas sogs bzhugs/ yang thog nyi ma lha khang du dzhai k+ṣim las grub pa'i thub pa grong khyer ma dang / 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra/bde mchog yab yum sogs bzhugs su gsol yod/ grwa tshang 'dir khang tshan bcu bzhi yod pa ni/ 1a mdo gzhung pa khang tshan/ 〉spom 'bor/ 3yer pa/4rong po/ 5tsha rdor/ 6tsha ba/ 7yong po/ 8rmar snyung / )a ra/ 19the bo/11rta dbon/ 19spo bo/ 13khung ru/ 14mi nyag bcas sogs yin/da lta'i tshogs chen ni/ lha bzang gis sde srid bkrongs pa'i sdig bshag tu bzhengs pa yin zer zhing / de'ang tshogs chen 'du khang ka ring 12la ka thung 96gi 'du khang nang rten gtso gser zangs kyi mi dbang byams pa thog so gcig lhag dang / de'i g.yas su byams chen chos rje'i sku brnyan dang thub pa gtso 'khor/ sgrol dkar tshe dpag med sogs dang / gtsang khang nub tu gnas bcu lha khang / gtsang khang dkyil du lha bzang gis bzhengs pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog so gnyis lhag gtsang khang shar du 'jigs byed lha khang /yang thog lha bzang byams pa'i zhal ras khang nang jo bo rje'i sku'i gzungs su nor bu bsam 'phel dang ring bsrel sogs bzhugs pa dang / tā ming rgyal pos byams chen chos rjer phul ba'i thub dbang gi zhal thang mkha' 'gro bkras 'thag ma/ gnas bcu'i gos thang / bka' 'gyur lha khang nang tā ming rgyal pos phul ba'i pad rag las bris pa'i bka' 'gyur ngo mtshar can/ gser bris kyi lañca'i brgyad stong pa/ rgyal ba lnga pas gnang ba'i bka' 'gyur/ pho lhayi dbang gis gnang ba'i bstan 'gyur par ma/ za dam kurma'i chos rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'i gos sku gling gsum ma/ yang thog tu dge slong ma pad+ma'i
thugs dam kyi rten/ gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang pos nyang bran bka' bsgo phug nas gdan drangs pa'i spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal dang / der smon lam 'debs pa'i sba 'khar de'ang gung ru rgyal mtshan bzang po'i phyag 'khar yin pa/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi rdo nag las grub pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/gzhan yang dgon der thog mar rgya dang / 'brong steng / stod pa/smad pa bcas grwa tshang bzhi yod pa la rjes su sngags pa dang / byes/ smad pa bcas grwa tshang gsum du sgril/ grwa tshad ni se ra lnga stong lnga brgya zer yang rjes su grwa grangs chig khri ma zin tsam dang / grwa spyil gsum stong lhag tsam yod/da lta grwa tshang gsum dang tshogs chen gyi rten gsum ni phal cher sngon gyi de rang dang / khang tshan ni phal che ba nyams gso dang / gsar bzhengs gnang ba yin/ khang tshan zhes pa ni/ grwa rgyun so so'i thob khungs la gzhigs nas dbyer yod stabs khang tshan so so'i ming yang lung pa so so'i ming thogs yod/yang dgon de'i ltag la gling skor lam steng du se ra chos sdings yod/ se ra dgon phyag ma btab gong rje tsong kha pa gnas der bzhugs/ gnas de ni rje tsong kha pa dang mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang mjal sa dang / dbu ma rtsa she'i ṭika chen gsung sa/ tā ming gong ma'i gser yig pa mjal sa rje tsong kha pas jo shāka rnam gnyis la dbu rgyan phul te lha ldan smon lam chen mo tshogs gnang ba dang / dga' ldan dgon pa phyag 'debs dgos thugs la 'khrungs sa sogs gnas der yin/ yang de nas mu mthud se ra'i rgyab rir 'dzegs na ri sked mtshams su dge legs snyan grags rgya mtsho'am rje sgrub khang pas btab pa'i se ra sgrub khang rtse'i gyang gog mjal rgyu yod/grwa bzhi dgon/ mtshan rgyas par grwa bzhi brtan bzhugs chos 'khor
gling zhes zhu/ se ra dgon nas g.yon ngos su spyi le gsum tsam mar yong na dgon der slebs/ thog mar gnas der bka' brgyud pa'i dgon gnas shigayod skad la rgyal ba lnga pa'i dus dge dgon du 'gyur/ de nas rgyal ba yabasras kyi brtan bzhugs dgon du 'gyur bas brtan bzhugs chos 'khor gling nya zhes pa'ang rgyal ba lnga pas btags gnang ba yin zer/ de rjes ke'u tshang 'jam dbyangs smon lam dus rgya skyed gnang ba dang / thog mar grwa grangs bzhi las med stabs grwa bzhi zhes pa de ltar dang de rjes dge 'dun nyer lnga bar 'phar/ sngon 'du khang ka ba 12kyi dbus su 'jim gyi rgyal ba lnga pa'i sku brnyan sku rgyab tu mtshan byang 'khod pa/ pang khebs steng mu tig gi 'brug ris yod pa zhig dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ rje yab sras gsum/ gnas bcu mda' tshad tsam/ ke'u tshang 'jam dbyangs smon lam gyi 'dra sku/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / rgya'i dmag dpon khag gi(pha'an)zhes rgya yig gi ming byang / srung ma lcam sring / rig pa'i lha mo/ srog bdag bka' 'gyur dpar ma dang / bstan 'gyur gser ris/ yang thog tu ke'u tshang rin po che'i gzims chung / de'i stong gser zangs kyi rgya phibs dang rgyal mtshan gnyis bcas yod/ shar du lha mo khang nang ge sar ram kre ris rgyal po zhes gong ma'i phul byung gi blon po'i sku brnyan red ces zer ba gnyis yod pas de'i mdun(khra'u cha'an)zhes pa'i mo 'debs srol yod/ mo yig ni rgya yig yin/de rjes rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i dus lha mo khang rgya skyed gnang / ke'u tshang sku thog gnyis pa 'jam dbyangs smon lam rgya nag gong mas gdan drangs rjes yar phebs skabs rgya yi lha mo zhig chibs zhabs su 'brangs pas da lta'i grwa bzhir phebs skabs da khyod gnas der sdod/ 'di nas 'ong sa med ces gsungs pa da lta'i grwa bzhi lha mo yin/ khra'u cha'an bod yig tu bsgyur/gzhis bdag ces pa ni/ lha khang 'og ste ya mon dmag sgar nas gdan drangs
pa yin/ da lta 'du khang rnying pa nyams gso gnang ba dang / 'du khang gsar pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i nang sngon gyi sku brnyan khag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/ sngon dgon de'i gsham du grwa bzhi ya mon lha khang dang / rgyab tu grwa bzhi dmag sgar/ de'i shar du grwa bzhi dngul par khang sogs kyi gnas yul yin/ke'u tshang nub ni khrod/ ke'u tshang nub ri khrod ni/ se ra shar dur khrod nas spyi le gsum bzhi tsam byang ngos glang chen ri brgyud nas 'dzegs na ri khrod der slebs kyi red/ (ke'u)zhes pa ni/ brag phug gam dben pa'i don dang / ri khrod der thog mar gung thang bla ma zhang dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs gnas dang yi ge a'i rang byon dang phyag rjes sogs yod pa la/ de rjes ser byes mkhan po byams pa smon lam sku na bgres po chags pa'i dus phyag mdzod kyis da khyed ni sku na bgres/ bla ma'i yang srid ni gcig las gcig sla ba zhig chags te mthar bla brang de sdig tshang lta bu zhig tu 'gyur gyi 'dugdes na mkhan rin po che sku tshe yun ring ke'u tshang ri khrod du bzhugs par mdzod/ khyed dgongs pa gzhan don du phebs na bla brang yang khyed kyi rjes su btang nas med pa bzo gi yin zhes zhus pas/ mkhan pos phyag mdzod lags de ltar ma gsung / nga yin cig thengs gcig 'ong dgos zhes gsungs pas/'o na khyed yin cig phebs na rdo ring lha lcam rang la phebs par zhu/ nga rtsad gcod bde zhes zhus pa ltar ke'u tshang byams pa smon lam gyi yang srid rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyi lha lcam la 1791lor 'khrungs/ mtshan la blo bzang 'jam dbyangs smon lam zhes gsol/ thog mar dge 'dun bzhi grwa gcig nas rjes su dge slong 27gyis gtsos dge 'dun bdun cu tsam bar 'phel/ sngon 'du khang ka ba drug nang rten gtso gser zangs kyi byams pa thog
so gcig tsam dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du ke'u tshang sku thog bzhi'i dngul gdung mda' tshad lhag dang / sku thog so so'i sku brnyan/ gser bris kyi brgyad stong pa dang / mdo sde skal bzang / yang thog lha khang nang gser zangs kyi thugs rje chen po mi tshad lhag dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du sa dge bka' rnying gi gsung 'bum mang po bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta sngon gyi khang bu mchod rten gyi shul du gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'dugang ka ba drug gi nang sngon gyi sku brnyan rnams kyi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod la 'khor lam spyir btang ba'ang yod/ke'u tshang shar ri khrod ni/ ke'u tshang nub nas byang lam brgyud song na g.yang gzar can gyi brag ldebs su chags yod/ ri khrod de ni dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus mjug tu se ra ke'u tshang 'jam dbyangs blo gsal gyis phyag btab/ rjes su phur lcog sprul sku na rim nas zhal bdag mdzad/ ke'u tshang shar nub ri khrod gnyis ni shin tu g.yang gzar che ba'i brag sked du btab yod pas sge'u khung nang nas 'og tu blta skabs lus kyi khrag rtsa yongs rdzogs 'then pa lta bu byed/ de'ang sngon bshan pa zhig lug gsod pa'i grab byas te gri brdar nas lug dang nye bar bzhag de nas lag pa bkru bar brtsam skabs lug des bshan gri'i steng thal ba g.yogs pa bshan pas mthong ste 'gyod pa drag pos/ nga ni sems can gyi srog gcod mkhan sdig can pa zhig yin 'dug nga lta bu shi na sems can 'di dag tshe thar snyam ste de mar ke'u tshang brag gi g.yang gzar can steng nas mchongs pas/ bshan pa der nges 'byung drag po de lta bu skyes pa'i stobs kyis sdig ltung rnams yongs su dag ste sa stong du ma lhung bar 'phur ba ltar dog bde mda'i zhing zhig gi steng du babs/ phyis su gnas der bsang khog cig kyang yod/ don de ke'u tshang du sgrub pa bskyon bzhin bzhugs pa'i mtshams pa zhig gis gzigs pas/ kho bshan pa mi tshe
sdig las kho na byas kyang da lam sa stong du ma lhung bar nam mkhar 'phags thub pas na/ nga mi tshe sgrub la brtson pa zhig sa steng du ci nas lhung snyam ste brag steng de las mchongs pas skad cig nyid du sa stong du rdab ste gshegs/ de'i shul du mchod rten zhig kyang bzhengs yod/ de ltar bshan pa dang mtshams pa gnyis skul slong 'khyer stangs kyis 'bras bu mi 'dra ba so sor byung /rwa kha brag rwa kha brag ni/ ke'u tshang nub nas chu tshod skar bcu grangs tsam gyen du 'dzegs na ri khrod der slebs/ ri khrod de ni/ spyi lo'i dus rabs 14par rje tsongakha pas phyag btab gnang mdzad 〈drang nges legs bshad snying po〉dag gnas der mdzad/ g.yas g.yon du mkhas grub rje dang /rgyal tshab rje'i sgrub phug kyang yod/ rwa kha brag ces pa ni/ rje tsong kha par gong gh+nā k+ham̐ hūm̐ ( lhadzo r+shahā sdishā spriswā gh+nā rnyi/nga hūm̐ hār+sha ldi snakā dzo r+sha paX phru( snashā rdzu( phru de'i nang du sku mtshams su bzhugs/ dam can chos rgyal gyis rje tsong kha pa'i rjes snyegs te 'ong bas gnas der slebs skabs brag ri sgo med de'i nang bzhugs yod pa shes te brag ri de'i gsham du dbu rwa brdar shul dang / de nas brag bshags te je tsong kha pa mjal stabs rwa kha brag ces pa'i mtshan de ltar byung gsungs/ de nas rje tsong kha pa sku gshegs pa'i phyi lo ste 1420lor byams chen chos rjes dga' ldan lnga mchod dang po ste rje'i dgongs rdzogs dang po de gnas der gtong gnang mdzad/ lnga mchod khang zhes pa'i lha khang de'ang de ltar byung / de rjes sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtsho nas a dga' bsod nams bzang po sogs kyis bskyangs/ sngon dge 'dun zhal grangs bcu dgu tsam yod/ se ra sgrub khang rtse'i khongs yin/ da lta gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i sgrub khang nang yi ge a'i rang byon dang / sngon gyi sgrub phug khag dang sku brnyan
gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/phur bu lcog mtshan rgyas par phur lcog rigs gsum byang chub gling zhes zhu/ rwa kha brag nas phred lam brgyud spyi le gnyis gsum tsam ri rgyab tu song na ri khrod der slebs/ phur lcog ces pa ni/ zhang 'gro mgon g.yu brag gis brag phur bu'i dbyibs can gyi steng du pho brang zur lcog btab pas mtshan de ltar thogs/ de nas spyi lo 1706tsam la sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtshor ma cigalab sgron gyi sras thos smon bsam grub kyis phu dog cing mda' bde ba'i yul dog bde ces par mkhar btab na bzang zhes lung bstan pa ltar gnas der phebs skabs der mchod rten dkar chung gis gtsos mchod rten kha shas dang / rigs gsum lha khang gi shul tsam la sgrub gnas btab/ sgrub khang dge legs rgya mtshos se ra rtse dang / rwa kha brag phur bu lcog bcas bskyangs gnang ba la/ rjes su phur bu lcog ngag dbang byams pa la gtad pas gnas ming bla mar thogs te phur lcog ngag dbang byams pa zhes pa de ltar byung /gnas der lo ltar lam rim gsungs/ thog mar 'du khang ka ba bzhi nas rim bzhin rgya skyed gnang ba dang / pho lha mi dbang dus chos rwa'i 'du khang chen mo sogs rgyas bskrun gnang / thog mar dge 'dun brgyad grwa gcig nas rim bzhin brgyad bcu tsam bar 'phel/ sngon 'du khang ka ba bzhi'i nang rten gtso sgrub khang dus bzhengs gnang ba'i 'jigs byed dang / sgrol dkar sogs kyi sku brnyan/ rigs gsum lha khang nang rigs gsum mgon po'i sku brnyan bzhengs gnang nas rab gnas mdzadaskabs yig drug gi rang byon du gzigs snang byung ba sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhugs su gsol/da lta gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i ri khrod nang sngon gyi sku brnyan khag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/ yang de dang nyer bar dus

kyisagatsug lag khang thobs la 'chad nyan bgyis dang bstan pa la phan pa rgya cher 'byung zhes lung bstan pas/ 'o na re zhig gsang bar zhu zhus pas gsang phu dang / de nas mi ring bar nyer chas ne'u les thogs te byon pas ne'u thog ces pa de ltar byung gsungs/ yang gsung srol gzhan zhig la jo bo des rngog legs pa'i shes rab la/ khyod kyi dgon pa gang du 'debs sam gsungs par legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu'i phyogs su phyag mdzub gtad de/ nga'i dgon pa pha khrir 'debs kyi yin zhes zhus pas/ 'o na re zhig gsang bar bya zhes gsungs pas gsang phu zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung zhes kyang gsungs/dgon de'i bka' srung gsang phu bse yi khyab can ni rgya gar nas legs pa'i shes rab kyi rjes su phebs pa la bka' srung yong min brtag phyir gsang mda'i thang du mu tig gtor gnang nas sgrug tu bcug gnang bas/ chos skyong gis a tsa ra thang gang la sprul nas de ma nyid du bsgrugs pas srung mar nyar rgyu gnang /thang de la da lta'ang mu tig thang zhes zer/ bse khyab pa gsang phur spro po yong ched dbu skra g.yon rir gtor gnang bas rgya ma sna rir shing sna sna tshogs skyes/dung chen 'bud stangs kyang glang chen pho mo'i skad ltar gnang / thog mar gnas der tsha ba dbon po dang / gling dbon po zhes dbon dgon thog so dgu thog can zhig yod skad la/ legs pa'i shes rab kyis jo bro bka' gdams lugs su bsgyur gnang yang / chos skyong gyi bskang gso dbon po brgyad ces pas gtong gnang ba yin/ de nas rim bzhin 'phel rgyas phyin te/lhag par du phywa pa chos kyi seng ge'i dus 'dzin grwa bskor nas bzhugs pa la phyir rgol gyis yar bzhengs te gzan phyed phabs nas dhi 0 skad gtang ba dang /gzan sked par dkris/ phyag gnyis brdab pa dang rkang pa ya gcig brdab pa sogs byas nas dri ba bton/ dam bca' bas phyir rgol gyi dris lan 'debs/lung rigs dang 'gal na phyir rgol gyis 'khor gsum bskor ba dang / lung

smon zhes pa ni/ sngon gu ru rin po che khul der phebs skabs thang dam bstan gsum(thang lha dam can bstan ma)gnas pa'i yul 'di smon dgos pa zhig 'dug ces gsungs pas smon zhes pa'i ming de ltar byung / 'on kyang kha rgyun du snon zhes zer/ nyi ma thang zhes pa ni/ rwa lo tsā bas ngas dgon pa nyi ma thang la phabs 'dra zhig bzhengs kyi yin gsungs pas nyi ma thang zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / yang ra lo tsā bas sgrub rtags ston te nyi ma thang la phab pas nyi ma thang zhes pa de ltar byung yang gsungs/ thog mar ra lo tsā bas phyag btab gnang ba la/ de rjes zhabs drung ngag dbang gzhon nu dang / zhabs drungasan rgyal/ zhabs drung nor bu gling sogs so sos rim bzhin dgon de bskyangs gnang mdzad/ zhabs drung zhes pa ni/ thog mar dgon so so'i mkhan po lo bcu dang / de nas gsang phu'i grong chung lo gsum grong chen lo lnga/khripa lo bcu bcas gnang rjes zhabs drung zhes pa'i mtshan thogs/ de nas dgon der gnyal gos 'dabs ma bsam grub ces pa grwa rgyun du phebs te mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas pas de'i sku phreng 1955lor zhing gshegs ngag dbang blo bzang bar sku phreng drug tsam byung / sngon grwa tshang gcig dang khang tshan lnga yod pa ni mnga' ris khang tshan dang / gung ru khang tshan/ 'dan ma khang tshan/ gnyal pa khang tshan/ lho brag khang tshan bcas yod/ mdo sngags gnyis ka phyag bzhed gnang / sngon dus 'gyur gong dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun cu ma zin tsam yod/ zhabs drung sman rgyal gyi dus su gso rig slob grwa'ang btsugs zhes gsung / sngon grwa tshang 'du khang ka ba bcu drug nang rten gtso 'jim gyi sman bla bde gshegs brgyad thog tshad ma dang / lam rim bla rgyud byis pa lo brgyad lhag tsam/ rgyal ba byams pa dang / tshe dpag med thog tshad ma/ dngul sku che chung bdun cu skor/ shar sla dang nub li'i gdung rten gnyis/ bka' 'gyur bris ma dang / bstan 'gyur par ma/ lhag tu gsung

nga'i bla ma 'dra 'dug gam zhes gsungs par/ nga 'dra yod ces sku des gsung byon pa dang / rab gnas nyin sku de sa la ma reg par bar snang la nyin bdun bzhugs stabs/ dngul sku bar snang zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung / gtso khang nang gong gsal gyi thub sku gzhu 'dom bcu gsum 'khor dang bcas pa dang /gser gdung chen mo'i lha khang nang gser gdung bzhi/ dngul gdung lha khang nang dngul gdung bzhi/ khang tshan so so la'ang sku gsung thugs rten ji snyed cig bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta dngul gdung lha khang las de min kun gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i gtso khang nang sngon gyi lha chen gyi sku tshab gser zangs las bzhengs pa'i sku tshad de 'dra dang / gzhan yang sngon gyi sku brnyan so so'i sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mang po/ tshogs khang chen mo'i nang sngon gyi dngul sku bar snang mas gtsos rigs gsum mgon po sogs sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang /rdo gcal du chos rgyal mnga' bdag khri ral dus btsugs pa'i rdo ring yang mjal rgyu yod/gnas nang dgon/ mtshan rgyas par gnas nang phun tshogs gling zhes zhu/ gnas nang zhes pa ni/ gnas tsa ri skor ba dang khyad med pas de'i nang sor chags pas gnas nang zhes zer/ kha stod nas byang ngos kyi ri ldebs su spyi le gnyis lhag tsam spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud song na zhal shar du phyogs pa'i dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni zhwa dmar sku phreng dang po rtogs ldan grags pa seng ges spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus 'gor phyag btab gnang mdzad/ rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge chibs drel dkar po zhig la chibs te gnas 'tshol du phebs skabs da lta'i dgon gsham du spang sdings zhig yod par gzims te bzhugs skabs sa der rdo je phag mo'i sku
dbyibs kyi gzigs snang byung / zhing skyong yab yum zhal gzigs te 'dre srin thams cad ri dwags su bsgyur gnang nas dgon de'i ltag tu shug pa gnyis yod pa so sor thim/ sa de gnas tsa ri dang khyad med du byin gyis rlabs gnang nas dgon de rdo rje phag mo'i sku spang nang du phyag btab gnang mdzad de garma bka' brgyud kyi phyag bzhed gnang / zhwa dmar sku phreng dgu pa bar dbyar kha yangs can dgon dang dgun kha gnas nang dgon du bzhugs/ de rjes kurma sku phreng brgyad pa dang dus mnyam par rgya gar mkhas pa drug gi ya gyal paṇa chen shes rab 'byung gnas kyi rnam sprul dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bar dpa' bo zhes pa'i che stod kyi mtshan dang dgon de gnang ba nas bzung dgon de'i dgon bdag gnas nang dpa' bo rin po che sku phreng rim byon gyis bskyangs/ da lta dpa' bo smra ba'i sgra dbyangs bar sku phreng dgu byung / dpa' bo gtsug lag 'phreng ba ni/ tshad ma'i gzhung la'ang shin tu mkhas pa rje tsong kha pa lta bu byung ste bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas te dgon de la'ang dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu skor 'dus/ sngon 'du khang ka ba nyer bzhi'i nang gser zangs kyi rgyal ba byams pa thog so nyis ldan dang de'i g.yas g.yon du sku rgyu de 'dra'i thub dbang mi tshad ma gnyis yod par bstan pa mes mi 'jigs pa'i me 'jigs ma dang / chus mi 'jigs pa'i chu 'jigs ma zhes zhu/ gser gdung lha khang nang zhwa dmar sku phreng dang po'i gser gdung zhes gser dang bye ma mnyam bsres kyis bzhengs pa'i sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten thog so nyis ldan dang / de'i ltag tu dngul gdung lha khang nang dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal gyi sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i dngul gyi gdung rten/ dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal gyis gter las bzhes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i rdza rnga zhes pa sogs rten dang brten pa ji snyed mjal rgyu yod/
da lta sngon gyi gyang gog steng gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i sngon gyi 'du khang gi gtsang khang sbug mar sngon gyi byams pa'i sku tshab 'jim gyi byams pa sku tshad de 'dra dang / g.yas g.yon gyi thub pa'i sku brnyan gyi sku tshab/ mkha' 'gro'i rdza rnga sngon gyi de rang / 'du khang nang g.yas su mkhan slob chos gsum dang /g.yon du mar me dwags gsum/ dpa' bo rin po che sku phreng rim byon dang /kurma pa sku phreng rim byon gyi ldebs ris sogs dang / gzhan yang sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs gnang ba mang po/ dgon de'i nye 'dabs su zhwa dmar sku phreng dang po dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal gyi sku rus bzhugs pa'i mchod rten gnyis/ rgyab ri'i ldebs su zhwa dmar sku phreng dang po'i thog ma'i bzhugs gnas/ byang shar gyi ri steng du bsam gtan rtse zhes dpa' bo sku thog rim byon gyi sgrub khang zhig kyang mjal rgyu yod pa bcas/snyan dgon pa/ mtshan rgyas par snyan bsam 'grub sgrol ma lha khang zhes zhu/ lum pa zam pa nas spyi le lnga drug tsam song na snyan grong tsho'i ltag tu btsun ma'i dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ snyan zhes pa ni/ gu ru rin po ches srin mo spun gsum brtul gnang nas thugs mnyes po byung bas mnyes zhes pa'i sgra de snyan zhes par 'gyur/ thog mar dgon de ri de'i rgyab ri'i ldebs su yod pa la rjes su gnas der chu med par gyur stabs da lta'i gnas der spos gnang mdzad de sgrol ma'i sku brnyan dang rje yab sras gsum sogs bzhugs pas sgrol ma lha khang zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ btsun ma grangs sum cu skor 'dus/'bras sgo mang sgra tshang gi khongs yin/da lta sngon gyi dgon de'i ltag tu gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang ka ba drug nang 'jim gyi thub dbang dang / rje yab sras gsum mi tshad ma dang /sgrol ma'i sku brnyan gyi sku tshab sogs gsar bzhengs dang bka' 'gyur gsar
blus gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/ yang de dang nye ba'i zas zhim zhes pa'i grongagi shar ngos ri steng du lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes phyag btab gnang ba'i zas zhim mgon khang nyams gso zhus pa mjal rgyu yod/mtsho smad dgon/ mtshan rgyas par mtsho smad phun tshogs gling ngam nub kyi rnam snang lha khang zhes zhu/ snyan nas spyi le lnga drug tsam snum lam brgyud song na dmar la 'byor zhing de nas lho ngos su dpyang zam thon nas spyi le gsum tsam spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud song na mtsho smad grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yo da/ mtsho smad ces pa ni/ yul de'i phu la bstan ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi bla mtsho yod pas de'i smad du chags pas na mtsho smad ces pa de nas byung zhes gsungs/ thog mar spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun par gnas der chos rgyal srong btsan gyis jo shāka rnam gnyis bzhengs bsgrubs rjes nub kyi rnam snang dkar po zhal shar la phyogs pa zhes pa'i lha khang zhig btab gnang mdzad/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'gor dbus gtsang mkhas pa mi bcu'i ya gyal klu mes tshul khrims shes rab kyis dge 'dun gyi sde gsar du btsugs/ ska ba shākya dbang phyug gis dar rgyas mdzad pa'i dgon zhig la/ bar skabs sa lugs su 'gyur ba'i mkhan po rdo rin pa/ rdor rgyal ba/ bsod nams don grub/mtshosmad mkhan chen shākya dbang phyug sogs rim pas bskyangs/ phyis tsha ba nam mkha' shes rab sogs kyi dus nas dge ldan lugs phyag bzhed gnang ste 'bras spungs su mtshan nyid dang / rgyud smad du sngags kyi slob gnyer gnang srol yod/ sngon 'du khang ka ba bcu drug gi gtsang khang sdug mar 'jim gyi rnam snang mi tshad ma dang / de'i zhogs su rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha khang nang 'jim gyi rgyal ba rigs lnga thog so gcig lhag dang / lha sa'i jo bo'i nye sras kyi dbyibs 'dra ba nye sras dang sgo srung / 'du khang nang rten gtso 'o brgyal jo bo

mdzad/ de rjes spyan snga ba'i slob ma dge bshes stod lung pa rin chen snying pos da lta'i dgon chags yul du spyi lo'i dus rabs 11par gnas spos gnang nas gnas der mdzad 'phrin rgyas te dge 'dun grangs mang 'dus/ sngon gzhung dgon yin pa la rjes su 'phan po zhog zhes par rgyud smad kyi dgon zhig yod par chu skyon byung stabs lam pa dgon mi ser dang bcas pa rgyud smad la gnang stabs de nas bzung rgyud smad kyi dgon lag tu gyur/ sngon 'du khang ka ba so bdun nang rten gtso thub dbang gi sku brnyan lam btsan gro chos sku ma zhes pa sku rgyu shar liṃ las grub pa zhig yod pa dang / de 'dra gsung byon ma gcig rtse po tā lar bzhugs pa dang gcig 'phan po lo dgon par yod/ dbu shog gser 'bur thon la gzhan rnams gser dngul gnyis las bris pa'i 'bum pod bcu drug glegs bam seng la gser dngul sogs kyis rgyan btab pa dang / dbu shog gser bris/ gzhan rnams nag bris yin pa'i bka' 'gyur glegs bam tsan dan las byas pa/ lo gcig dus gcig las mi bkrol ba'i sil snyan nam mkha' bya lding zhes pa/ gtsang khang spug ma'i gdung rten lha khang nang dge bshes bya yug pa'i sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i gdung rten bkris 'od 'bar dang / 'brug pa kun legs kyi sku rus cha tshang bzhugs pa'i gdung rten bkris 'od bkra sogs gsung rten mang po dang / bka' gdams mchod rten mang po/ dbu rtse ka ba bzhi'i nang gter las bzhes pa'i rtswa ram pa dang / spen ma las grub pa'i ka gdung / bal bris kyi ldebs ris/ 'du khanganang bal lugs kyi jo bo gsung byon ma sogs sngon gzhung gi gan mdzod gnyis pa'i gras su tshud ces gsungs/da lta sngon gyi 'du khang gi shul du 'du khang ka brgyad gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i nang rten gtso 'jim gyi thub sku lam btsan gro chen po dang sgrol ma/rje yab sras gsum sogs gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / bka' 'gyur par

nang 'gro mgon chos 'phags kyis sa mtheb skyu re la gzungs sngags 'bum re bgrangs gnang ba'i dgyes rdor gyi sku byis pa lo brgyad tsam dang / dpal mgon zhal sogs rten sku ji snyed cig bzhugs su gsol yod/ snye thang lha chen po'ang 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa'i dus brkos gnang ba yin zhes zer/da lta nyams gso gnang ba'i sngon gyi 'du khang nang sngon gyi rten sku de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/ra stod dgon/ mtshan rgyas par snye thang bde ba can stag tshang gser srang rnam 'grel grwa tshang ra ba stod thos bsam nor bu'i gling ngam/ bya bral kun spangs grwa tshang zhes sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs tsam dang / snye thang sgrol ma lha khang nas nub ngos su snum nag 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gsum tsam dang / de nas byang ngos su spyi le bzhi tsam bskyod na grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ thog mar gnas der ser khyim bde ba can zhes dgon zhig yod pa la jo bo rje snye thang du bzhugs skabs ska ba shākya dbang phyug gis gtsang dgon du bsgyur gnang mdzad/ de rjes rim bzhin rgyar skyed de grwa tshang gcig dang khang tshan dgu bar 'phel/ khang tshan dgu po ni nya ra khang tshan dang /rtsed thang khang tshan/ gnyer shar khang tshan/ gsang sngags khang tshan/'phyongs rgyas khang tshan/ spyan g.yas khang tshan/ jo gdan khang tshan/ 4byams gling khang tshan/ chod pa khang tshan bcas yin/ de dag gi grwa rgyun yul lung de dag nas phebs dgos pa dang / sngon grwa rgyun lnga brgya lhag yod/ dbus gtsang gi gdan sa chen po gsum ste bde ba can dang / gsang phu/ gung thang bcas kyi ya gyal yin/ sngon grwa tshang 'du khang ka ba bzhi bcu'i gtsang khang spugs mar rten gtso sman 'dam gyi dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi thub dbang sku ni rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i thugs dam gyi rten yin pa thog so gnyis ldan la
nye sras sgo srung dang bcas rten sku mang po/ yang steng li ma lha khang nang li ma kho na'i sku brnyan bzhugs pa/ khang tshan so sor yang rten dang brten pa bcas bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta nyams gso gnang ba'i grwa tshang 'du khang nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / bka' 'gyur/ rje tsong kha pa'i gzims spug dang bzhugs khri/ klong rdol bla ma rin po che'i gsol lcoggzhan yang ldebs ris rnying ma mang po bcas mjal rgyu yod/ra stod ces pa ni/ sngon gsang phur khang pa med stabs ra skyor bskongs nas bzhugs gnang mdzad stabs ra stod ra smad ces pa byung zhes dang / yang gsang phu'i gdan rabs kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtshos mdzad skabs khong gis gsang phu'i gdan sa pa dang gling smad chos rje zung 'brel gnang / dge 'dun phal che bas rje bla mar dad kyang nyung shas kyis sun 'byin byung bar brten grwa tshang gi stod du rdo'i ra ba bskongs te chos 'chad nyan gnang bas ra ba stod ces pa de ltar byung zhes gsung /gserasrang zhes pa ni/ rje tsong kha pas rgyal tshab rje la gser srang gang gnang nas khyod kyis rnam 'grel grwa tshang zhig thobs shig gsungs par/ rgyal tshab jes gser de smar khams pa grags pa rgyal mtshan la gnang ste rnam 'grel grwa tshang zhig 'debs su 'jug gnang bas grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gser srangagang des bde ba can ra stod dgon de rnam 'drel gyi 'chad nyan gnang sar bsgyur gnang mdzad/bya bral zhes pa ni/ dgon de'i chos gzhis gnyer tshang dang bcas bla brang la sbyar te bya ba kun spangs pas bya bral kun spangs grwa tshang zhes pa de nas byung ba bcas dang /yang dgon de'i nub ngos nor bu ri zhes pa'i ri ldebs su klong rdol bla ma
rin po che'i ri khrod dang / de'i g.yas su sgrub phug cig yod pa la rlung rdol sgrub phug ces klong rdol bla ma rin po che la rtsa rlung gi rang dbang thob nas sgrub phug rdol ba red ces sgrub phug der thog med pa dang / klong rdol/ zhes pa'i mtshan yang de'i zur chags gsungs/yang de'i steng du 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras bzhugs myong ba'i sgrub phug tu 'bras spungs kyi dge lam rim pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyang bzhugs myong ba/ yang dgon de'i nub byang gi ri ldebs su bsam gtan gling zhes zhu bar klong dol bla ma rin po che'i dgun kha'i bzhugs gnas dang mthar dgongs pa gzhan don du phebs sa dang sku gdung bzhur 'bul zhu ga'ang gnas der yin cing der gdung rten mchod rten yang bzhugs/ de'i g.yas su bya rgod sgrub khang dang / steng du brag lcog sgrub khang / ra stod dgon pa'i rgyab rir mkhas sgrub phyung po rnam rgyal gyi sgrub phug yod pa der mgon po phyag drug zhal gzigs pas ri de la'ang ra stod mgon po ri zhes zhu/ mgon po ri'i shar ngos su rmog lcog rin po che'i bzhugs gnas rmog lcog ri khrod/dgon de'i kha sprod lho ngos su sa skya'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa chos rdzong zhes pa dang / de'i 'og tu rje tsong kha pa'i sgrub phug yod la rje rin po ches bde mchog gi rgyud gsan sa'ang gnas der yin/ de'i 'og tu lag ra zhes par mtha' 'dus yang 'dul kyi ya rgyal srin po gan rgyal kyi lag steng du 'khel ba'i 'jam dga' chos khang zhes pa khang rnying de'ang mjal rgyu yod/ ra stod dgon nas mar yong dus lam 'og tu lha rgyab sprod ces pa'i pha bong zhig la rgyab mdun gnyis gar sgrol ma'i sku brnyan re yod pa de ni bla ma rin po ches dgon der 'dod yon rgyas na slob gnyer la gnod pas 'dod yon bkag ched du bzhengs pa yin gsungs/ yang de dang nye bar mching mdzod rtsom pa po rgya mching ru pa'i sku gdung mchod rten zhig yod pa dang /
mching ru pa ra stod du yun ring bzhugs pa'i lo rgyus yod/gnam 'brug dgon/ mtshan rgyas par gnam 'brug se ba byang chub chos gling dgon zhes zhu/ ra stod nas snum nag lam brgyud spyi le gsum bzhi tsam song na gnam mdar slebs shing de nas byang ngos su spyi le nyer lnga tsamañcar btang 'khor lam brgyud gnam phur song na dgon der slebs kyi red/ dgon de ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis par 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis rang gi bla ma sgrub chen gling ras pas lung bstan pa ltar phyag btab gnang gadzad/ de'ang gtsang pa rgya ras gling ras pa'i bka' bzhin ra stod phu brgyud rtse ba la nas mar phebs skabs da lta'i dgon chags yul du 'brug ma smad gsum sa la babs nas yod pa nam mkhar 'phur ba gzigs pas da nga'i dgon pa gnas 'dir 'debs la dgon ming la'ang 'brug ces 'dogs dgos dgongs/ yang la las dgon de phyag 'debs nyin 'brug sgra chen po bsgrags pas 'brug pa zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung gsung / gang ltar de nas mched pa'i chos lugs la 'brug pa bka' brgyud ces zer/ thog mar dgon de chags yul du yar 'brog stag lung pa'i gces phrug bdun rngon rgyag bzhin yod pa la gtsang pa rgya ras kyis bden bzhi'i chos gsungs pas rngon pa de rnams blo chos su khug nas ri dwags rngon byed mda' gzhu sogs bla mar phul te rab tu byung / mda' gzhu lha khang gi dral mar btang bas lha khang gi mtshan la'ang mda' gzhu lha khang zhes zhu/ de nas rim bzhin rgya skyed du phyin nas slob ma mang po 'phel/ ri'i g.yas g.yon gang sar slob ma'i bzhugs gnas khang chung mang po da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ kun gyis nā ro mkha' spyod nyams len gnang nas sgrub rtags kyi rtsal thon/ rtsa rlung la rang dbang thob ste mtshan mor sku lus la chu yang yang byug gnang mkhan mang po byung / tshogs pa che bas
mugnas gcig tu rub mi thub stabs nyer lnga tshe bcur dgon de'i lho ngos kyi rgya ras sgrub phug ces pa'i steng du dar chen zhig yod pas de sku bzhengs zhus pa dang / nyer lnga tshes bcu yin pa'i brda ru go nas gsol tshogs 'tshogs kyi yod/ de nas mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas te mi phyed 'brug pa dang / 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed sgrub thob ces dang / stod 'brug gnam gyi skar ma/smad 'brug sa yi rtsi shing / bar 'brug dbu chen gdugs thob nyis stong snga brgya la sogs kun la grags/ jun gar dmag dus smug pas btums te dgon de ma mthong ba yin zhes nyams chags ma byung yang de nas dus skabs shig ring nyams chags byung ste rgyal ba lnga ba'i dus jo bo'i mchod thebs zhes ru ba gnyis kyang 'dzugs gnang dgos byung / de rjes bstan rgyas gling rgyal thog skabs gzhung dgon du bsgyur gnang mdzad/ sngon 'du khang ka ba so drug nang kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi bka' 'bum par shing dang / mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje'i bka' 'bum par shing / 'brug pa'i chos 'khor gyi par shing sogs 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi par khang lta bur gyur/ gtsang khang spug mar shar li las sgrub pa'i jo bo byang chub che mo la sman 'dam gyi nye sras brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / g.yas g.yon du gdung rten bzhi dang / rin chen las bris pa'i bka' 'gyur/ gzhan yang li ma'i sku brnyan ji snyed bcas yod/da lta gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i jo khang nang sngon gyi sku rgyu sman 'dam las grub pa'i jo bo byang chub chen mo'i sku tshab dang / rgyal ba mi 'khrug pa stong sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/gzhan yang de'i khor yug tu rgya ras sgrub phug ces pa dang / pa ri byang chub gling gi shul/ dgon gsar gyi shul/ 'brug pa kun legs kyi zhabs rjes/de nas mar lam spyi le bcu gnyis tsam gyi sar ri brag ces pa'i lho nub lung shur nang 'brug dgon gyi dgon lag nyams snang zhes pa'i btsun dgon zhig
dang 'gro mgon rgya ras kyi sgrub phug bcas mjal rgyu yod/'jang dgon/ mtshan gzhan la 'jam dgon yang zhu/ gnam mda' nas spyi le bzhi lnga tsam snum nag 'khor lam brgyud song na 'jang smad dang / de nas spyi le gnyis gsum tsam nub byang gi ri 'dabs su spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud song na 'jang phu zhes pa'i dgon der slebs kyi red/'jang zhes pa ni/ 'jang sa dam gyi yul yin zer/ dgon de ni thog mar 'jang sngon mkhyen pa zhu bas phyag btab gnang mdzad pa dang / snye thang ra stod kyis gnas der dgun chos 'tshogs gnang bas slob gnyer shin tu 'phel/ de rjes gdan sa gsum dang mnga' ris dwags po grwa tshang bcas lo ltar bod zla 11tshes1nas bod zla 12tshes 15bar zla ba phyed dang gnyis ring dge 'dun lnga stong tsam gnas der 'dzom gnang nas gzhung chen ka pod lnga las rnam 'grel gtso bo 'chad rtsod gnang ste rtsod pa'i brdar sha phal cher gnas de nas chod pa byed/ gnas der gtso bo tshogs chen gcig dang /gdan sa so so'i tshogs chen/ grwa tshang / khang tshan dang bcas pa'i khang pa so sor yod/ gzhan yang gnas der rten khyad par can jo bo mthong ba don ldan dang / grogs khyad par can dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho/ khro khyad par can tshogs khro sangs rgyas bem po zhes sogs dang / lhag par du gnas der 'jang rdo bcal sngon mo zhes tshogs chen rdo bcal kyi 'og tu rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi ral gri rgyu bzhin yod pas de steng du phyag 'tshal ba dang 'og tu ral gri rgyu ba dus mtshungs na shes rab 'phel zhes nyin ltar dge 'dun rnams tshogs grol ma thag rdo bcal steng du phar spos tshur spos byas nas phyag 'tshal ba yin/de'i ring gi chos thebs ni sde pa gzhung nas gnang ba dang / 'du bkod ra stod nas gnang ba/ rgyun gtan tshogs chen gyi sku gnyer yang ra stod nas
gtong gnang dgos/ dgun chos kyi tshogs shing gtso bo ra stod nas 'bul dgos kyang sngon rje tsong kha pa'i srol yin zhes bod zla 11tshes30nyin 'jang phu nas la bskyon te ge ra lha dkar te chos rgyal nor bzang gi pho brang zhes par zhag gcig bzhugs pa dang / der phebs pa'i lam bar nas shing phran bu re bsnams phebs pa dang / ge rar zhag bzhugs gnang dgos/ sprul sku rnams las grwa dmangs ni zan khang sogs gang rung du gzim pa/ phyi nyin mar phebs skabs chu pags bzhes sa zhes par rje tsong kha pa'i srol ltar bzhes khu chu byas nasagasol ba mchod kyi red/ de nas 'jang smad du gsol 'dzer gnang ste 'jang dgon du phyir phebs nas tshogs shing rnams rung khang du phul srol yod pa de la shing slong zhes zer/da lta sngon gyi tshogs chen 'du khang nyams gso gnang ba'i nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab 'jim sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / gdan sa khag gi 'du khang yang gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/'ur zhang lha khang / mtshan rgyas par 'ur zhang rdo yi lha khang ngam/rdo dpe med kyi lha khang zhes zhu/ smon ngam stag gdong zhes pa nas spyi le brgyad tsam dang / yang na snye thang dpyang zam nas spyi le gsum bzhi tsam spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud song na phang gong zhes pa'i grong gi shar ngos su lha khang de mjal rgyu yod/ lha khang de ni bod rgyal zhe gcig pa chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi ya gyal/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyis spyi lo'i dus rabs dgu par bzhengs gnang mdzad/ phang gong zhes pa ni/ yul de3la grong 'phrang gi 'go la chags pas 'phrang gong zhes thogs pa dang rjes su ra btags dor nas phang gong zhes par sgra 'gyur/ kur zhang zhes pa ni/ lha khang de myur du bzhengs pa'am/ kur te bzhengs stabs kur zhang zhes pa de ltar byung gsung / sngon
tshad lhag dang mgon po phyag bzhi sogs sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/shug gseb dgon/ mtshan rgyas par shug gseb yo rgyan rdzong zhes zhu/ kur zhang lha khang nas spyi le bcu gsum tsam spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud shar du song na snye phu zhes shug gseb ri 'dabs su slobs/ de nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig lhag tsam song na dgon der slebs kyi red/ shug gseb ces pa ni/ shing shug pa'i gseb tu chags pas shug gseb ces zhu/ dgon de thog mar phag gru'i zhal slob chos rje gyer sgom tshul khrims seng ge dgung lo sum cu lhag tsam gyi dus 1181lor gnas der phebs nas grwa dgon zhig phyag btab gnang mdzad/ slob ma stong phrag mang po byung gsung / zhi byed kyi gcod rgyud phyag bzhed mdzad/ shar gling dang / nub gling / dbus gling zhes gling gsum tsam yod/ shug gseb bka' brgyud ces pa'i mtshan yang de nas byung / de jes kun mkhyen klong chen pa bsam yas mchims phur bzhugs skabs dgon de'i gnas bdag g.yu sgron ma mi'i gzugs su byon nas kun mkhyen pa nga'i gnas su byon par zhu/ zhes zhus nas da lta'i dgon de'i steng gangs ri thod dkar zhes par spyan drangs/ klong chen snying thig gong ma ste ya bzhi mdzod bdun sogs gsung rtsom phyag dpe mang po gnas der gtan 'khel ba gnang skabs/ ma mos yi ge bris/ dam can gyis shog bu bzos/khyab 'jug gis snag tsha dbur ba sogs ma gza' dam gsum bran du bkol/de rjes jun gar dmag dus thor zhig tu song / de rjes rgyal ba skal bzang dus sbe ser nas sku gnyer bzhi grwa gcig gnas der bzhag gnang ba dang de'i gsol phogs snye phu gzhis ka nas phul srol yod/ ra stod nas shug pa dang ljagaspa'i khral skul ba'ang chag yang thob/ de rjes sems nyid stobs ldan zhu
ba'i sgrub chen zhig gnas der phebs nas bzhugs skabs skyabs mgon dharma seng ge'i zhal slob rig 'dzin chos nyid bzang mo ste yongs grags su shug gseb rje btsun rin po che/ ma ṇi lo chen zhu bas sems nyid stobs ldan gyi zhabs la gtugs nas dgon de'i dgon bdag gnang ba nas bzung mtshan snyan yongs su khyab nas zhal slob btsun ma lnga brgya skor 'dus/ gtso bo klong chen snying thig phyag bzhed mdzad pa la gang nyid ma gcig lab sgron gyi rnam sprul yin zhes zhi byed gcod rgyud gyi chos 'khor ser skya mang por bskor bas mtshan snyanakha ba'i ljongs su khyab/ sngon 'du khang ka ba bcu drug lha ldan gtsug la khang gi 'khyams ra 'dra ba'i nang gi rten gtso shar li'i jo bo thog so nyis ldan la khri rgyab yol gser zangs las grub pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du bka' gdams mchod rten thog so phyed gnyis can gnyis dang chung gcig zhal shog gser bris can gyi rgyal ba'i gsung rabs kyi kun dga' ra ba/ 'jim gyi rgyal ba byams pa thog so gnyis ldan dang / gu ru gtso 'khor mi tshad ma/mgon po phyag bzhi/ gser zangs kyi chos rje gyer sgom dang / sems nyid gong ma'i 'jim gyi gdung rten sogs bzhugs su gsol yod/da lta sngon gyi 'du khang rgyab tu gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang ka ba 24nang rten gtso 'jim gyi gu ru snang srid gzil gnon mi tshad lhag dang /thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje btsun sgrol ma/ rdo rje sems dpa'/kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ 'jigs med gling pa/ rje btsun chos nyid bzang mo bcas kyi sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/dgon de nas mu mthud ri ldebs su rkang thang mar chu tshod phyed lhag tsam song na gangs ri thod dkar zhes par kun mkhyen slong chen pa'i gzims spug dang / sku brnyan/ sgrub khang gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs dang / 'o ma chu mig sogs mjal rgyu yod/

byang chub gling / mtshan rgyas par byang chub gling lnga phan bde legs bshad gling zhes zhu/ 'jang smad nas chu shur ngos su spyi le bcu tsam snum nag 'khor lam brgyud song na har sag ces pa'i grong du 'byor zhing / de nas byangangos su spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le bzhi tsam song na dgon der slebs/ dgon de'i kha sprod chu phar nang du ljon zhes pa'i yul dang lha sa'i skyid chu dang / yar klung gtsang po'i 'dus so'ang gnas der yin/ thog mar gnas der bka' brgyud pa'i dgon chung zhig yod pa la de rjes rgyal ba sku phreng lnga pa'iri snying thig skor gyi lnga pa'i cho ga bcu gsum zhes pa phyag bzhed gnang ched du snying dgon du bsgyur gnang mdzad stabs gzhung dgon du 'gyur/smon lam tshogs chos sogs su phebs dgos pa dang gzhung gi glud 'gong brdzong ba sogs gnang dgos/ sngon 'du khang ka ba nyi shu tsam nang rten gtso sman 'dam gyi rgyal ba byams pa thog so gnyis ldan dang / gu ru dang rgyal ba lnga pa sogs kyi sku brnyan dang dngul gdung sogs yod/ dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya ma zin tsam gyis lnga pa'i cho ga bcu gsum phyag bzhed gnang gi yod la/lo ltar bod zla 5tshes10gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi sgo nas gar 'cham yang gnang srol yod/da lta sngon gyi bka' brgyud kyi 'du khang red ces pa nyams gso gnang ba'i nang gu ru'i sku brnyan dang / rgyal ba lnga pa'i sku brnyan sogs 'jim sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/thar pa gling / thar pa gling ni/ da lta'i chu shur rdzong nas sbyi le brgyad tsam song na thar pa gling grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ thog mar dgon de rnying dgon yin pa la rgyal ba skal bzang dus dge ldan par bsgyur
gnang rjes rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gzhis dgon du 'gyur/ thar pa gling gi sde'ang rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi yin/ skyabs rje khang gsar rin po che'ang gnas der yum ring bzhugs shing mthar dgongs pa gzhan don du phebs sa'ang gnas der yin/ dgon de nas grwa pa lnga re zla re byas nas rtse la rgyun mchod par phebs dgos shing / rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi grwa skal gcig gi 'gyed rdzogs gnang srol yod/ rgyun du rgyal ba rin po che'i zhabs rim sgrub pa dang /skabs re khrag sde las khungs kyi dngos rdzas dbor skyel sogs las ka tsag tsig gnang dgos/ sngon 'du khang ka ba nyer gnyis nang rten gtso thub sku thog rtseg ma dang / rgyal ba byams pa/ gu ru rin po che/ rje tsong kha pa bcas kyi sku brnyan dang / rin chen las bris pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur sogs mjal rgyu yod/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang ka ba lnga'i nang rje yab sras gsum dang /thub dbang gi sku brnyan sogs gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/dgon de nas spyi le bdun tsam song na ba ta zhes par byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po'i mgon khang dang / dgon de nas rkang thang mar chu tshod bzhi tsam song na dgon shog skor pa zhes par dgon de'i dgon lag rin chen gling zhes pa zhig yod pa der mkhan po byang chub 'byung gnas dang / mkhan po dad pa shes rab sogs kyi sku brnyan mang po yod kyang da lta nyams gso zhu thub med/chos 'khor yang rtse/ da lta'i chu shur rdzong nas spyi le bdun tsam snye mo'i phyogs su snum nag 'khor lam brgyud song na lam steng du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ thogs mar gnas der kurma bka' brgyud pa'i dgon zhig yod pa la rgyal mchog lnga pa'i dus dge lugs pa'i dgon du bsgyur gnang rjes gzhung
dgon du 'gyur/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i bca' yig kyang yod/ sngon grwa tshad brgya dang bco lngas mdo sngags zung sbrel phyag bzhed mdzad de bod zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer dgu nyin dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas gar 'cham dang gtor rgyag gnang srol yod la/ gzhung chen la'ang gsan bsam gyis rtsod grwa dang / dbyar chos dgun chos sogs tshogs gnang gi red/ sngon 'du khang ka ba nyer gnyis nang rten gtso gser zangs kyi thub sku rgyan spros ma thog so gsum ldan khri drug 'gyog dang bcas pa dang / g.yas su dzhai k+ṣi gyi rgyal ba byams pa/ gzhan yang sman 'dam gyi sku brnyan mang po/ gnas bcu lha khang /sgrol ma lha khang 'jun gar dmag dus sgrol ma'i phyag mdzub la lcags 'dzer 'debs skabs a tsha zhes gsung byon pa'i sgrol ma a tsha ma zhes pa la sogs pa mjal rgyu yod/da lta gsar bzhings 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis nang sman 'dam gyi ston pa dang / 'jam dbyangs/ byams pa sogs dang / mgon khang nang 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa dang / rnam sras/ dam can chos rgyal/ dgon de'i srung ma dmag zor ma sogs gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/skyed tshal dgon/ chos 'khor yang rtse dgon nas mu mthud spyi le bcu gcig tsam snum nag 'khor lam brgyud song na tsha rags zhes par 'byor zheng de nas byang ngos su spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gsum tsam song na zhabs rig grong tsho'i steng du dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ zhabs rig ces pa ni dgon de'i chags dbyibs rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku pang nang du chags pas skyid tshal dang / de'i 'dabs kyi grong la zhabs reg ces sgrol ma'i zhabs la reg pas zhabs reg ces pa rim bzhin zhabs rig ces par sgra 'gyur/ thog mar sa skya'i bla ma paṇa chen lha dbang blo gros sa skya nas phebs te gam pa la'i rtse nas
gzigs skabs gnas de thun mong ma yin par gzigs nas der dgon zhig 'debs dgos thugs la 'khrungs te dgon de 'debs gnang mdzad/ de rjes paṇa chen gyi sku skye rgyal ba blo gros chos 'phags lha rtogs gzhis ka zhes par 'khrungs te mdzad pa bskyangs/ dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga brgya tsam zin zhesagasungs/ sa skya ngor lugs phyag bzhed gnang gi yod pa la rjes su rnying lugs byang gter yang zung 'brel gnang yod 'dug sngon 'du khang ka ba nyer bzhi'i nang rten gtso gser zangs kyi thub dbang thog so gsum ldan gyi mtha' 'khor du sman 'dam gyi nye sras sgo srung dang bcas pa dang / rin chen las bris pa'i 'bum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ bka' 'gyur bris ma/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ rnying ma brgyud 'bum la sogs dang / dbu rtse lha khang nang gdung rten mang po/ 'du khang gi rgyab lam 'bras lha khang ka ba bzhi'i nang du gser zangs kyi gdung rten dang / li ma dang gser zangs kyi bla brgyud cha tshang / gzhan yang gnas brtan lha khang / mgon khang shar nub gnyis las shar mgon po phyag drug sogs dge lugs dang / nub sa lugs kyi gur zhal sogs mjal rgyu yod/da lta sngon gyi 'du khang shul du gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang ka ba brgyad ldan nang rten gtso thub dbang dang / g.yas su spyan ras gzigs/g.yon du gu ru'i sku brnyan sogs 'jim sku thog so gcig ldan gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / gtso bo byang gter phyag len gnang gi yod/yang de nas byang shar gyi ri ldebs su gter ston pad+ma gling pas phyag btab gnang ba'i sgom chen zhes pa dang / yang rkang thang mar chu tshod gcig tsam song na 'khrul po zhes par btsun ma'i dgon zhig dang / chu tshod gnyis tsam song na g.ya' sngon zhes par btsun ma'i dgon zhig dang / yang chu tshod gnyis tsam song na ri sne zhes pa'i grwa dgon sogs kyi rjes shul mjal rgyu yod//
