1059lor brag steng gi dbu rtse dmar po zhes pa phyag btab gnang nas khong gi zhang po sku zhang chos rje zhu ba sku tshab tu 'jog gnang mdzad/ bka' gdams pa'i chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa'ang gnas der zhabs bcags myong yod/ de rjes thon pa tshang zhes paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyal gyi yongs 'dzin/ rgyal ba lnga pa'i dbu bla gnang ba mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtsho zhu bas 'du khang mthil zhes ka ba nyi shu can gsar bskrun gnang ste dge ldan lugs phyag bzhed mdzad/ lhag tu dgon 'di'i mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags zhu ba'i skabs mdzad 'phrin shin tu rgyas te dge 'dun grangs lnga brgya bar 'phel/ gtso bo gzhi gsum gyi phyag len mi nyams pa'i thogri bo dge lugs kyi gsang sngags grwa tshang zhig tu gyur te gzhung dgon ang gnyis pa'i gras shig yin/ sngon 'du khang mthil ka ba nyi shu'i gtsang khang spug mar rgyal ba byams pa thog so gnyis lhag tsam dang / 'du khang nang gtsang kha'i jo bo zhu ba gser zangs kyi jo bo khru gang pa zhig yod pa de ni sngon rgan mo zhigayar klungs gtsang po dang snye mo'i rma chu 'dus pa'i khar 'bud shing 'thu skabs phyag la 'jor thebs pas a tsha zhes gsungs byon pa dang / rgan mos sku de chos sde dgon par 'bul dgos bsam pa la/ chos sde dgon las rgyal byed gling na dga' zhes gsungs/ 'du khang nang gdan drangs rjes/ legs so zhes gsungs lan gsum byon par grags pa'i sku brnyan dang 1048rod 'go brtsam ste 'jim bzo mi bdun gyis dus yun lo sanyigs cam spyad pa'i thog so phyed gsum gyi rje yab sras gsum/ mgon khang nang 'jigs byed dpa' gcig dang / mgon po phyag drug dam can chos rgyal/ dpal ldan lha mo/rnam sras gnod sbyin bzhi/ gzhis bdag rdzong btsan sogs dang / bka' bstan 'gyur sogs bzhugs/ dbu rtse dmar por sku zhang chos rje'i gsung rten dang / ston pa'i sku brnyan thog tshad ma'i thugs bar 'brom ston par rnyed
gnang ba'i ston sku mkhyid gang pa/ dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge'i sku gdung /gnas brtan brag ri/ bka' gdams pa'i bla brgyud khru gang tsam/ mkhas grub rje dang / legs ldan rje/ rab 'byor gyi sku brnyan mi tshad ma sogs mjal rgyu yod/da lta dbu rtse dmar po nyams gso zhu thub med kyang / 'du khang mthil nyams gso zhus pa'i nang sngon gyi rgyal ba byams pa'i sku gzugs rang 'jags la dbu gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / mgon khang sngon gyi de rang / rje yab sras gsum gyi sku tshab mi tshad ma sogs gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/yang dgon de'i rgyab rir mārma dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sgrub phug dang /snye mo gzhu'i nang dgon de'i dgon lag kun rwa zhes pa dang / yang rab rgyas gling zhes dge lugs pa'i dgon zhig rta'u dgon zhes bka' brgyud pa'i dgon zhig kha che paṇa chen dang / mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ tshad med bsod nams bzang po sogs bzhugs myong ba'i dge 'dun sgang zhes pa'i dgon sogs mjal rgyu yod/chos sde dgon/ mtshan rgyas par gtsang gi snye mo bye mkhar chos sde dgon zhes zhu/ bye mkhar zhes pa ni/ snye mo rma chu yun ring rgyugs pas bye ma mkhar te phung gsog thebs pa'i steng du mkhar btab pas mtshan de ltar byung /da lta'i snye mo rdzong nas nub byang gi mtshams su spyi le 2 min tsam dang / sngon gyi snye mo rdzong shul nas shar ngos su spyi le 2lhag tsam gyi sar sngon thang stong gis bskrun pa'i lcags zam gyi khar bo dong lugs kyi dgon de mjal rgyu yod/dgon de ni thog mar chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan snye mor phebs skabs nas yod skad la/ thog mar dpal 'chi med dpal bzang gis phyag 'debs gnang mdzad de snying thig phyag bzhed mdzad/ de rjes bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal
gyis rgya skyed gnang nas mdzad pa shin tu rgyas te dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun bcu skor gyis gtso bo shar gter yang gsang dkon mchog spyi 'dus dang /gshin chog kun rig rnam snang sogs phyag bzhed dang / gzhi gsum gyi phyag len mi nyams pa mdzad kyi yod pa la gzhung chen mor thos bsam gnang bar sde dge dang / ngor dgon e bam chos sde/ 'bras spungs sogs la slob gnyer du grwa rgyun mang po btang gnang gi yod/ sngon 'du khang ka ba sum cu'i gtsang khang sbug mar rten gtso gser zangs kyi thub dbang dang / g.yas su spyan ras gzigs sems nyid ngal gso/ g.yon du tshe dpag med bcas kyi sku brnyan thog so nyis ldan dang / mtha' 'khor du gnas brtan brag ri ma dang sgo srung rgyal chen sde bzhi dang / rdo dkar gas grub pa'i phyag rdor dang / rdo nag gi rta mgrin sogs dang / mgon khang dam bcad ma'i nang dmag zor mas gtsos bstan srung sum cu so gnyis tsam/ gzhan yang rten sku mang po/ yang steng bka' 'gyur lha khang nang bris ma dang par ma sogs kyi dpe cha/ gsum thog steng rdo rje phag mo'i gzim chung / bzhi thog la mgon khang sogs mjal rgyu yod/da lta sngon gyi bzhi thog las gzhan rang 'jags mjal rgyu yod pa'i 'du khang nang gi gtsang khang sbug ma'i rten gtso 'jim sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / phyag rdor dang rta mgrin sngon gyi de rang / 'du khang nang gu ru'i sku brnyan dang / bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/'gro ba mchod rten/ mtshan rgyas par rang byung mchod rten nam rdzus skyes pad+ma gling zhes kyang zhu/ 'gro ba mchod rten zhes pa ni/ gnas der brtsig pa med par rang bzhin du 'khrungs pa'i rdo'i mchod rten ngo mtshar can
zhig yod stabs mtshan de ltar thogs/ mchod rten der skor ba bsags na las sgrib dag pa dang bud med sbrum ma tshos skor ba bsags na ma bu bde sgrol 'byung zhes gsung / de'i zhogs su mchod rten zhabs ra zhig yod pa de'ang 'tshar longs yong bzhin pa la bud med rabs chad cig gis pha bong zhig red snyams te rkub stegs byas pas de nas bzung 'tshar longs mi byung ba red ces gsung srol yod/ bsam gtan yang rtse nas spyi le gsum tsam lho nub ngos dang / pa gor zhes lo chen be+e ro tsā na'i 'khrungs khang dang nye bar song na dgon der slebs kyi red/ sngon gnas der rang byung rdo yi mchod rten ngo mtshar can zhig las med pa dang 1980lor bsam gtan yang rtse'i btsun ma kha shas shig gis mchod rten gyi zhogs su sgrub khang chung chung zhig bskyon nas sku mtshams su bzhugs nas pad+ma gling pa phyag bzhed mdzad/ de rjes mkhan po tshul khrims rgya mtshos rgya skyed gnang nas da lta btsun ma tshos kurma bka' brgyud phyag len gnang ba red/ mdor na sngon gnas der mchod rten las dgon pa medapar da cha gsar bzhengs 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis nang rten gtso chos lung sprul gsum gyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma dang / yang steng du bka' 'gyur lha khang dang / rigs gsum mgon po'i lha khang / 'du khang 'og tu gu ru gtso 'khor gsum gyi 'jim sku dang / gser zangs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig khru gang tsam/ ldebs ris zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang tshe dpag med dang / 'od dpag med/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs kyi zhing khams dang / ra sgor nang btsun ma'i shag 'khor bcas yod/yang bsam gtan yang rtse nas spyi le gsum tsam nub byang du song na sgrub gzhung zhes pa'i ri 'debs su sgrol ma phug ces pa'i btsun dgon dang / yang de'i shar ngos su byi'u mdo dgon zhes pa'i btsun dgon sogs mjal rgyu yod/
ru dgon/ mtshan rgyas par dpal ldan smin sgrub chos sde dgon nam/ru dgon gtsug lag khang zhes zhu/ dpal ldan smin sgrub chos sde ni sku zhang bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis gsol ba yin/ da lta'i snye mo rdzong nas spyi le bcu tsam mtsho mig ces pa nas gyen du 'dzegs te dus 'khor bla mtsho ste ru mtsho'i nang 'khor du song na mtsho de'i byang ngos su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar chos rgyal srong btsan dus rgya bzas ru gnon du gtsang g.yas rur gtogs pa mtsho ngos ru mtsho kha pa zhes phyag btab gnang ba dang / de rjes bu sngon sku zhang kun dga' snying po sogs byon/ de rjes sku zhang sangs rgyas dpal 'byor dus chos 'khor rgya cher spel gnang mdzad/ yum gyi dgongs rdzogs ched sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa la sku yi rten la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos blangs dkyil 'khor ma dpe mtsho de ga'i nang nas gsal ba zhig dang / gsung gi rten la dus 'khor gyi rtsa 'grel phyag dpe mang po brkos gnang mdzad/ thugs kyi rten la dgon de'i g.yas g.yon so sor byang chub mchod rten thog gso dgu byas pa zhig dang / bdun byas pa zhig bzhengs gnang mdzad/ dge 'dun zhal grangs stong kha zin pa la/ shar gling grwa tshang dang / ba sding pa grwa tshang / gling stod grwa tshang / byang grwa tshang bcas grwa tshang bzhi yod/ grwa tshang gzhan rnams sngon nas thor bshig tu song yang sding pa grwa tshang gi 'du khang ka ba 18nang gi rten gtso hroṇ+ḍam gyi thub dbang sku brnyan mda' tshad ma dang / sku rgyu de 'dra'i sman bla dang / mi 'khrug pa/ bka' bstan 'gyur par ma/ 'bum bris ma gnyis/ rin chen sna lngas bris pa'i dam bcad ma pod lnga bcu skor/ sman 'dam gyi bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku brnyan mi tshad ma/ ru sprul sku sku phreng bzhi pa'i dngul gdung / gzhan yang rten sku ji snyed/ gtsang khang spug mar li ma'i thub dbang gi sku brnyan/ lha
sa'i jo bo dang sku tshad mnyam pa gnyis dang sku rgyu de 'dra'i sman bla'i sku brnyan dang dus 'khor/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i sku brnyan byis pa lo brgyad tsam/ lhag tu rnyikhrim dmar po'i byams pa bzhengs bzhugs byis pa lo brgyad tsam zhig yod pa de thog mar snye mo gtsang khang zhes par mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa rgad mo zhig tsher ma 'gog bzhin pa'i skabs tsher 'jor byams pa'i zhabs sus la thebs te sku khrag thon stabs rgad mo shums pas byams pas gsung byon te nga rgyab ri brag dang mdun du mtsho yin par skyol cig gsungs par thog mar sbas ra zhes par gdan drangs pas nga ru mtsho khar skyol cig gsungs pa bzhin dgon der gdan drangs zhes gsungs/ sku gsung byon ma'i grags pa kun tu khyabs stabs sne pa gzhung nas rtsad gcod byas pas de 'dra'i sku brnyan zhig bzhengs te ngo ma de ma bstan pa'i lo rgyus kyang yod pa'i sku brnyan de dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams mchod rten che chung sna tshogs stong kha zin pa/ sku zhang bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang sangs rgyas dpal 'byor gyi gser gdung thog so gcig ldan/sman 'dam gyi rgyal ba tsong kha pa mi tshad/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje dang / rgyal ba lnga pa'i sku brnyan/ sngon dgon der me skyon 'byung skabs ma 'tshig pa'i tsan dkar po las grub pa'i dzam lha gnyis sogs mtha' 'khor chos gshoms nang bzhugs su gsol ba/ gzhan yang mgon po phyag drug dang dpal ldan lha mo/rnamasras phyag rdor sogs kyi sku brnyan dang / lha mo dang rnam sras kyi mdog sogs bzhugs su gsol ba mjal rgyu yod/da lta sngon gyi grwa tshang / sding pa zhes pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang ka ba nyer gnyis nang rten gtso sngon gyi byams pa gsung byon ma dang /gzhan yang 'jim gyi bu ston gyi sku brnyan dang / tshe lha rnam gsum/ mkhan slob chos gsum/ rgyal ba mi 'khrug pa/ gu ru rin po che/ lha mo sogs kyi sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / bka' 'gyur dang 'bum par gsar/
tshe chog dang gsung rnam/ chos spyod sogs kyi par shing ring thung brgya lhag bzhugs su gsol ba mjal rgyu yod/dgon de nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gsum tsam song na shar ram zhes par skyob pa 'jig rten mgon gyi grwa dgon shel dkar sgrub sde zhes pa zhig dang / yang chu tshod bzhi tsam song na rtag spyan dgon zhes pa'i btsun dgon/mar lam mdo gsum zhes par ma gcig lab sgron gyi sgrub khang khos kham zhes pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/bzang ri dgon/ mtshan rgyas par lhun grub mthong smon zhes zhu/da lta'i snye mo rdzong nas spyi le bzhi tsam byang du 'khor lam brgyud song na bzang ri grong gi rgyab rir dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar bon gyi sprul sku gshen chen klu dga' sku mtshams su bzhugs skabs srid pa rgyal mos lung bstan du bka' phebs kyi slob bu bzhi yod pas de dag la chos gnang dgos zhes gsungs pa ltar bru gtsang / rme'u gtsang / spa gtsang / khu gtsang /bcas 'od gsal lha las mched pa'i bru zhu spa rme'u gshen dang lnga bcas par chos zab mo gnang rjes/ da so so'i gdan sa so sos 'tshol cig gsung par gtsang thob rgyal du bru gtsang / sbra chen du spa gtsang / rgyal rtse dang nye bar zhu gtsang / stod dar steng du gshen gtsang / gnas der rme'u gtsang bcas chags/ dgon de phyag 'debs pa po ni bla gur zhogs pa zhes pas/ rta nagmi nag phyi nag gi tshul byas nas phebs skabs yul mis khams pa slebs byung zer nas bla ma brdung pas gnas skabs gnas de dang nye ba'i shar ngos khams pa lung zhes par bzhugs te de la'ang dgon pa chags/ de nas slob ma mang du byung bas da lta'i dgon chags yul du thog mar ri khrod chung chung zhig chags/ de rjes 'gro mgon gsum stong lha 'bum gyi sku dus su dge 'dun
gsum stong bar 'phel te gsum stong lha 'bum zhes pa'i mtshan yang de ltar byung / mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel gnang mdzad/ a khrid dang /snyan rgyud/ rdzogs chen ste a snyan rdzogs gsum gyi bstan pa'i srol gtod de ljags rtsom mang po gnang / sngon 'du khang gong 'og gnyis da lta'i dgon gsham du chags yod pa la re rer ka ba bcu drug gi sa la rten gtso ston pa gshen rab kyi sku brnyan sogs li sku bcu drug gnas de nas 'khrungs pas snye mo li yi li tshang zhes pa de nas byung / gzhan yang gsum stong bla ma'i smar gdung sogs rten sku ji snyed yod/ dbu rtser jun gar dmag gis rtsa gtor btang /da lta dbu rtser gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang ka ba bcu gcig nang rten gtso sman 'dam gyi ston pa gshen rab dang / mkhas dbang tshul khrims dpal chen dang / 'gro mgon gsum stong lha 'bum/ mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan/ rdzogs sku gshen lha 'od dkar/smra seng 'jam dpal dbyangs/ yum chen shes rab byams ma/ kun bzang rgyal ba 'dus pa/gzhan yang bon gyi bka' 'gyur dbu med pod brgya dang lnga bcu dang / bstan 'gyur dbu med pod sum brgya lnga bcu sogs mjal rgyu yod/be+ero dgon/ mtshan rgyas par snye mo khyung tshang brag ces zhu/ da lta'i snye mo rdzong nas byang shar ngos su spyi le gcig lhag tsam song na rtags ri zhes pa'i logs su khyung tshang phug dang / de'i 'og tu 'du khang chags yod/btsun dgon de ni thog mar gu rus chos rgyal khri srong la lung bstan pa la snye mo bye mkhar chos sde zhes par yab hon 'dod dang yum bram ze bka' brgyad ces par khyi'u gyis pa lo brgyad pa zhig yod pas de ni khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin pas byis pa de slong dang ster ba yod gsungs pa ltar rgyal blon dpon g.yog rta pabargyad phebs nas byis pa mang po'i dkyil nas be+e ro khyad du 'phags par
gzigs nas khyod kyi pha ma'i ming la ci zer gsungs par/ pha ma'i mtshan ji bzhin zhus/ pha gang du song ngam zhes dris par/ pha chang mchod du phebs pas gtam 'tshol du song zhes gsungs/ yum bzhu snum 'tshol du phebs pas mig 'tshol du song zhes gab tshig gi lam nas gsungs/ rgyal blon rnams kyis da nga tshos 'tshol dgos pa'i byi pa 'di rang red 'dug dgongs nas mnyam du bu'i khyim du phebs/ yum la mig spor cig gsungs pas yum gyis bsnams phebs pa'i snum gyis gsal me spar/ yab la gtam zhus shig gsungs par yab sku ra sbir bas gtam mang po zhus/ rgyal pos bu bsam yas su gdan 'dren dgos gsungs par/ yab yum gnyis kyis ngos gnyis la bu 'di rang las med pas gnang ba gnang rogs zhus par yab yum gnyis kyi 'tsho gos rgyal pos gnang rgyur zhal bzhes te bsam yas la gdan drangs/ rgya gar la lo tsā slob tu phebs pa'i nang nas phul du byung ba'i rtsal thon/ de rjes gnas der phebs nas gu ru dang / khri srong / be+e ro bcas gsum lhan du sgrub pa mdzad/ gu rus sgrub phug 'di cung chung drag 'dug gsungs nas che ru btang gnang ba'i sku rjes kyang yod/ so sos 'jim gyi sku brnyan re bzhengs gnang ba'i 'dam bag cung zad re lhag pas da 'dis ci byed gsung par gu rus 'dis srung ma zhig bzhengs gsungs te rta mgrin gyi sku brnyan zhig bzhengs gnang mdzad/ rjes su sku de rtse pho brang du gdan drangs pas sku gnyer gyis sku 'di gang du 'jog gam gsung skabs/ nga 'dir mi sdod snye mo khyung tshang du skyel rogs zhes gsung byon pas sku rang 'jags su gdan drangs/ lo ltar gzhung nas gser ḍi re dang sku gnyer la 'bru khal gsum re gnang srol yod/sgrub phug nang dbus su gu ru dang / g.yas su khri srong / g.yon du be+e ro bcas kyi bzhugs gnas dang / rten gtso rta mgrin gsung byon ma dang shod du 'du khang ka drug nang gtso bo gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku brnyan dang / g.yas su khri
srongagayon du be+e ro bcas sku brnyan mi tshad ma sogs sku brnyan mang po mjal rgyu yod/da lta gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i sngon gyi 'du khang de 'dra'i nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod la de'i g.yas su mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang / g.yon du lha lcam sidha ra ba'i sgrub phug kyang mjal rgyu yod//

'jim gyi gu ru'i sku brnyan mi tshad ma gtso bor gyur pa'i gu ru'i sku brnyan stong tshar dang / bka' 'gyur dpar ma sogs mjal rgyud yod/gnam mtsho/ mtshan rgyas par gnam a sngon thang la lhung 'dra ni/byangagi gnam mtsho phyug mo yin zhes zhu/ da lta'i 'dam gzhung rdzong gi byang ngos su spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud la rgan la zhes pa brgyab ste spyi le bdun cu don lnga tsam song na gnam mtshor slebs/ mtsho de ni bod rang skyong ljongs khongs gyi tshwa med mtshi'u che shos de yin pa dang / mtsho de'i spyi'i rgya khyon ni spyi le gru bzhi 1920tsam yod pa dang / brgya cha bzhi bcu zhe lnga 'dam gzhung rdzong gi khongs su gtogs/ de 'phros dpal mgon rdzong khongs yin/ mtsho ngos kyi mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos gas spyi khre 4118yin/ gnam mtsho ni/ gnyan chen thang lha'i 'dabs sam byang ngos su yod pas gnyan chen thang lha'i btsun mo bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal rdo je kun grags ma zhes zhu ba de yin gsungs la mtsho'i dbyibs kyang rdo rje kun grags pa'i bzhugs stabs ltar yod/gnyan chen thang lha ni srid pa'i lha chen 'ol de gung rgyal gyi sras yin cing chos rgyal srong btsan dang / khri srong lde'u btsan sogs kyis bston pa'i srid pa'i lha dgu'i gras yin/ thang lha'i btsun mo gnam mtsho ste bstan ma rdo rje kun grags ma sogs gu ru rin po ches dam 'dogs gnang ba'i bod skyong lha srung yin/gzhan yang 68grags pa'i mtsho chen bzhi la phyag rjes bzhag ces pa'i gcig niganam mtsho yin la/ pur rgyal bod kyi dzengs 'dir dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi gnas te/ sku'i gnas mchog gangs dkar ti si dang / gsung gi gnas mchog gnam mtsho phyug mo(la lar la phyi gangs kyang gsungs )thugs kyi gnas mchog tsā ri ṭa zhes grags pa las gsung gi gnas gnam mtsho la'ang sku yi gnas mchog bkra shis do ba che dang / gsung gi
gnas mchog bya do nam mkha' do/ thugs kyi gnas mchog ma chags se mo do bcas tshang nas yod gsung / gtso bo shar kyi bkra shis do ni mtsho sgo yin zhes ngo mtshar che ba'i ri 'bur gnyis chags yod pa dang shar kyi ri 'bur ni khro bo khrag 'thung bcu gnyis dang / nub kyi ri 'bur ni zhi ba bdun bcu rtsa lnga yin zhes gsungs/ ngo mtshar che ba'i brag ri ka ba ltar ker rer langs yod pa ni/bstan ma'i sgo srung yin zhes dbus su gu ru'i sgrub phug nang gu ru'i sku brnyan dang / de nas g.yas skor du 'gro dus nub tu chu sgo ste der kha dang lag pa khru ba/ de nas gu ru dang / mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ stag lung ma rin po che sogs kyi zhabs rjes dang / rigs gsum mgon po dang / gu ru rin po che sogs kyi sgrub phug rga lo'i gzims phug mgon po phug sgrol ma phugyo rgyan phug bka' thang phug zhabs drung phug bar do'i phrang la sogs pa ngo mtshar che ba'i phug pa dang rang byon mang po/ gzhan yang mtsho de'i lho la gur chung dgon pa/ nub la do rgya dgon pa/ byang la bya do dgon pa/ shar la bkra shis do bo che bcas mtsho sgo bzhi'i tshul du mtha' 'khor du yod/ lug lo'i 'khor chen zhes pa ni/ spyir gnas so sor gnas lo zhes gnas sgo 'byed pa'i lo de gnas lor rtsis stabs gangs dkar ti si rta lo dang / gnam mtsho lug lo/ tsā ri sprel lo bcas yin/ gnam mtsho'i skor chen skabs gnyan chen thang lha'i ri bo dang mtsho gnyis ka bskor dgos pas rkang thang mar nyin 15 —25tsam 'gor/ mtsho gcig po bskor na rkang thang gi nyin 7 — 9bar 'gor/skor dus ni nam skor dbye ba med kyang mi tshogs mang shos ni bod zla bzhi pa dang lnga par yin/ se mo do mtsho dkyil du yod stabs dbyar dus mjal bar bskyod mi thub pa las/ gzhan rnams mjal thub la gnas lor bskor na phan yon che ba sogs gsungs so/

'phyag mas 'phyag rgyu thon pas rten 'phyag sgang zhes pa'i mtshan de ltar byung /dur khrod kyi dkyil du dur rdo 'ja' zug ma zhes pa zhig yod pa de ni mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgya gar sil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas gdan drangs pa dang /rgyagar khyi spyang gis rjes snyegs te der thim zhes dang / gzhan yang dur rdo gsung byon ma dang / phyogs bzhir rdo bzhi yod pa mkha' 'gro ma bzhi/ rje skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi zhabs rjes sogs mjal rgyu yod/yang 'bri gung mthil nas rkang thang mar nyin gcig tsam song na tsha yug gamatsha kug ces par skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po dgung lo bzhi bcu phebs skabs mtshams su bzhugs sa'i sgrub phug rdo rje lho dkar zhes par rang byon dang sku rjes ngo mtshar che ba mjal rgyu yod//gter sgro dgon/ gter sgro zhes pa ni/ gnas de'i tshogs khang dbu rtse la sogs pa'i brag ri rnams mdog dkar la gnam du 'phyo bas bya ti pa'i sgro dang 'dra bas ti sgro zhes dang / yang gnas der nor dang chos kyi gter kha bsam gyis mi khyab pas byur bur gtams pa'i sgrom dang 'dra bas gter sgrom zhes gsung srol mi 'dra ba so sor yod/ 'bri gung mthil nas mar yong dus spyi le 10tsam spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud reb nang zhes par song na btsun dgon der slebs kyi red/ reb ces pa ni gu ru rin po che dang jo mo mtsho rgyal la bsam yas su bdud blon rnams gyis bar chad brtsams par gu ru yabayum 'od kyi da ler bzhugs nas byang phyogs su byon pas da lta'i gter sgro'i thad kur rab rib kyis yal song bas rib nang zhes pa'i ming de ltar byung ba yin/ thog mar gnas der gza' dang / klu bdud nag mo/ dam sri sogs kyis 'dzin pa'i bdud lung zhig yod pa la gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas gnas der phebs nas lha 'dre rnams dam 'dogs gnang ste lung pa byang blta
de lho blta dang / bdud lung de chos lung la bsgyur gnang mdzad/ yul de'i phu ru chu tshod phyed tsam song na bdud 'dul phug ces pa'i gu ru'i sgrub phug dang / mtha' 'khor du mkha' 'gro bye ba'i dbu skra zhes shug pa mang po yod/da lta'i chu tshan chags yul der thog mar klu bdud nag pos bdud chu bskyil yod pa la/ gu rus a phyi chos sgron la khyed kyis bdud chu 'di gshongs shig gsungs par/ a phyis me long gis brag bshags kyang chu bshangs mi thub pas gu rus khyod bud med kyis las de tsam las ci 'ong gsungs te rdo rje g.yugs gnang bas brag brtol te chu bshangs/ sems can gyi nad la phan pa'i chu tshan de bzhag gnang mdzad/ chu tshan de ni rdo sol dang / mu zi nag po/ cong zhi dkar po sogs las grub pa dang / chu'i tsha tshad ni hre hri tu'u 40yan rgyun 'khyongs thub/ chu tshan de la bzhugs pas smug po dang / snying / tshad pa/grang ba/ mkhris pa/ pho ba/ mchin pa/ rlung / mkhal ma/ skyed pa/ dreg grum/ chu ser/ zha rengs/ rtsa dkar/ pags nad mdze sogs 'jom zhes dang / yang de dang nye bar shwa ba chu tshan zhes sngon shwa ba rkang pa chag pa zhig chu des drag skyed byung ba'i chu tshan zhig yod pa de la rus pa chag skyon byung rigs rnams la phan pa yin zhes gsungs/ thog mar 'du khang chung ngu zhig las med pa dang / de rjes gnas der sgrub pa pho mo mang po bzhugs kyang 'du khang med cing bsnyen bskur mang ja sogs byung na hom khung gdong zhes da lta'i 'du khang gnas yul der tshogs nas bsngo smon sogs gnang ba yin/ de rjes bdud 'dul rin po ches 'du khang chung ngu zhig bzhengs gnang ba dang / grub dbang ngag dbang rin po che byon te yang zab kyi nyams len dar rgyas che ba byung / de rjes gdan rabs so bzhi pa dkon mchog bstan 'dzin zhi ba'i blo gros gyis 'dugang steng 'og bar gsum rgya cher btang gnang ste spyi pa thog mar tshugs/rten gtso gu ru mtshan brgyad dang / je skyob pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas/
bstan srung a phyi sogs kyi sku brnyan mang po bzhugs pa mjal rgyu yod/da lta ni sngon gyi 'du khang shul du gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang nangasngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang g.yas g.yon du btsun shag chu tshan khar 'grul khang legs nyes sna tshogs yod pa bcas/chos lung dgon/ nyi ma lcang rwa nas shar ngos su spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le 6tsam song na chos lung mdo brgyud byang ngos kyi ri khug tu btsun dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni spyi lo 1215lor 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon gyi thugs sras chos sku rin po che zhu bas phyag btab gnang mdzad/ de'ang skyob pa rin po ches slob ma rnams la 'dra sku re gnang ste khyed tshomi res dgon re 'debs dgos gsungs pa ji bzhin chos sku rin po ches dgon de nyid btab gnang mdzad/ de rjes 'bri gung g.yu sgra sprul sku rim byon gyis yang ri sgar bla brang dang bcas skyong gnang mdzad pas yang ri sgar gyi dgon lag tu 'gyur/ sngon 'du khang ka ba brgyad kyi nang rten gtso skyob pa rin po che'i 'dra sku mda' tshad ma dang / phag gru'i 'dra sku gsung byon ma sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhugs su gsol/ btsun ma brgya skor gyis 'bri gung bka' brgyud phyag bzhed mdzad pa yin/da lta gsar bzhengs 'du khang nang tshe dpag med dang / mkhan slob chos gsum kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa/ klong chen rab 'byams pa sogs kyi 'dra sku gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/ma ra dgon/ mtshan rgyas par ma ra bya yul thub bstan rnam rgyal gling zhes zhu/ chos lung mdo nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le 2tsam
song na dgon der slebs kyi red/ dgon de ni dge bshes bya yul pas phyag btabaganang mdzad stabs rjes su bya yul pa'i rnam sprul gling rin po che'i ma dgon du gyur/ dgon de ni sngon nyams gso gnang gtan 'khel yang ma 'grub pa ni 'du khang nang klu me long gdong can gyi klu khang zhig yod pas yin/klugazhan rnams dam 'dog gnang yang klu me long gdong can gyis nga mi phud par zhu zhus te dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus te bstan pa srung rgyur khas blangs/da lta'ang 'du khang nang klu me long gdong can gyi klu khang yang yod/ sngon dge ldan gling / thub bstan gling / rnam rgyal gling sogs gling gsum yod pa la dge 'dun bzhi stong bar 'phel zhes gsungs/da lta sngon gyi 'du khang nyams gso gnang ba'i nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba mjal rgyu yod/rtalha khang / mtshan rgyas par dbu ru zhwa yi lha khang zhes zhu/ ma ra dgon nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le 2tsam mar yong na dgon der slebs kyi red/ dgon de ni myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'am ban de myang ting nge 'dzin zhes pas phyag 'debs gnang mdzad/ myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi sku dus su rab tu byung zhing / paṇa chen bi ma la mi tras snying thig gi man ngag yongs rdzogs gnang/ bod rgyal khri lde srong btsan sad na legs mjing yon sku na byis pa'i dus su bu rdzi dang rjes su chos blon mdzad de ban de bka' chen po zhes par gtogs te btsan po dang chab srid la sri zhu bla na med pa gnang ba'i bdag rkyen du btsan pos zhwa lha khang gi rdo ring du 〈bka' gtsigs 〉zhes byas rjes dang slad btsan po rim byung nas dmigs bsal gzigs rtogs gnang dgos skor rdo ring la bris pa'i ma yig deb ther la'ang 'khod yod/ de rjes rim zhin nyams rgud du song ba la
rgyal ba klong chen pas nyams gso gnang nas klong chen snying thig phyag bzhed mdzad yul du 'gyur/ sngon lha khang de'i 'khyams kyi dbus su khra men mchod rten zhes pa zhig yod pa de ni zhwa yi lte gnas su yin pa dang de'i 'og tu dam sri sdug pa can gnan yod pa klong chen pas slar yang gnan/ glang dar dus 'gyel ba'i rdo ring yang bslang / jun gar dmag gi skabs su 'bri gung rig 'dzin chos grags kyis mthu bskyon pas sog dmag gis dgra byed mi thub ces gsungs/ gzhan yang dgon der phyogs bzhir dar chen bzhi dang / dur khrod bzhi/ bla shing bzhi/ mchod rten bzhi sogs yod/da lta sngon gyi rdo ring dang / g.yu sgron ma'i bla shing sogs dang / 'du khang dang mchod rten gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/a yang dgon/ mtshan rgyas par thang skyabs a yang dgon nam e wam dgon zhes zhu/ thang skyabs nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gnyis tsam song na rtsa smad grong zhes par 'byor zhing de nas 'khor lam med stabs rkang thang mar chu tshod gnyis tsam song na dgon der slebs kyi red/dgon de ni thog mar g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis 1359lor phyag btab pa'i e wamadagon zhes dang de rjes dga' ldan dgon gyi dgon lag tu 'gyur/ a yang zhes pa ni/ 'bri gung nang ka mad sum cu'i rim pa ltar gyi dgon pa yod pa la 'di ni gsal byed kyi mtha' ma a yig ming can gyi dgon de yin zhes gsungs/ de rjes mtshungs med bla ma rin po che zhu bas dgon de bskyangs gnang mdzad/ dge 'dun sum brgya skor gyis ri bo dge lugs phyag bzhed mdzad par gyur/ sngon dgon der rten gtso a yang sgrol ma gsung byon ma zhu ba zhig yod pa de thog mar lha sa gtsug lag khang nang yod pa la de rtag tu zhal shar du phyogs pas sku gnyer gyis sgrol ma 'di ci yin zhal sgyur bzhin 'dug
ces gsungs par sgrol mas nga sdod sa a yang dgon du yin zhes gsungs pas rjes su dgon der gdan drangs zhes dang / gzhan yang rten sku ji snyed bzhugs su gsol yod/ rgyab ri bde mchog gi gnas ri yin zer ba dang /chu mig cig yod pa de la bde mchog gi zhabs chu/ dur khrod la'ang pus mo dur khrod ces bde mchog gi zhabs pus stong du yod ces pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/ da lta sngon gyi gyang gog steng gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i 'du khang nang sngon gyi sku brnyan de dag gi sku tshab gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang / yang de nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gsum tsam song na g.yu bu dgon zhes pa de mjal rgyu yod/thang skyabs dgon/ thang skyabs lcags zam nas spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gcig tsam song na thang skyabs grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ko sham pa chen pos phyag 'debs gnang mdzad/ ko sham pas dgon de phyag ma btab gong gnas der nyi ma lha khang zhes lha sa gtsug lag khang ma bzhings gong pad+me lhaḥpa m+bhi pahā gh+nā ༵༵ ༵༵ zhu)sna r+yaṃ k+ṣiṃ ༷༷ gyis ga〉zhe zlo gh+nā hā (3 r+sha ñcā brnyan bye ma a 'khrungs las grub pa sogs yo/da gsungs/ de rjes ko sham pas rgya rdo las brtsigs pa'i 'du khang bzhengs/ thang skyabs zhes pa ni/ sngon jun gar gyi dmag gnas der lhags te me rgyag skabs sku gnyer gyis mgon po beng gi zhal thang zhig yod pa de bstan pas me shi stabs thang skyabs dgon zhes dang / phag mo dgon/ ba dgon pa/ nyi ma thang / be gser/ rnam rgyal ser khang bcas kyis rgyun chos gnang dgos/ dgon der gtso bo nyi ma lha khang ka riring bzhi dang/ 'du khang ka ba nyi shu rtsa bzhir dge 'dun brgya lhag gis ri
bo dge ldan phyag len mdzad pa yin/da lta sngon gyi nyi ma lha khang dang / 'du khang rnying pa'i ldebs ris/gzhan yang sku brnyan gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs mjal rgyu yod/ci yang dgon de nas rkang thang mar chu tshod gsum tsam song na skam skam zhes par rwa sgreng gi dgon lag gcig dang / yang mu mthud song na g.yag sde paṇa chen gyi slob mas phyag btab gnang ba'i 'od sna dgon zhes pa sogs mjal rgyu yod/ga tshal dgon/ ka tshal dgon ni/ mal gro gung dkar rdzong nas snum nag 'khor lam brgyud spyi le gcig tsam dang de nas spyi le gnyis tsam byang ngos su spyir btang 'khor lam brgyud song na ka tshal grong dbus su dgon de mjal rgyu yod/ dgon de ni thog mar mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang yin cing / de'ang chos rgyal srong btsan gnas der phebs skabs shwa ba yu mo zhig sngon du 'gro ba'i gzigs snang byung / de nas yu mo yal ba dang yu mo'i gtsug tor gyi tshul lta bu zhig bzhugs pas chos rgyal gyis gnas der lha khang zhig btab/ gtsug lag khang nang chos rgyal nyid kyi 'dra sku dang / phyag 'khor sogs yod 1553lor rje btsun rin chen phun tshogs kyis der yod bka' gdams kyi dgon shul dang ka tshal lha khang sbrel te ka tshal sgrub sde btab/dgongs pa yang zab dang / dzā sper nyams len gyi srol gtod de 'bri gung pas bdag gir mdzad/ rje skyob pa 'jig rten mgon dang / rje rin chen phun tshogs sogs kyi sku brnyan/ rje rin chen phun tshogs kyi sku gdung gi cha shas bzhugs pa'i mchod rten bkra shis 'od 'bar sogs rten gsum khyad par can dang / rgyal ba tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gzims khang sogs yod la gseg shang gan+di'i lha khang zhes pa zhig kyang yod/ gseg shang zhes pa ni thub

rgyal tshab dar ma rin chen dang / 'dul 'dzin grags pa rgyal mtshan gnyis la ljags bkod mdzad de dgon pa 'debs pa'i dbu 'doms su bkod/ khong rnam gnyis gyis dge 'dun lnga brgya skor dang / gzhan yang drung rin chen dpal dang rin chen lhun po/ gzhis ka sne'u pa/ sde srid phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po/ sde pa skyid shod pa/ sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan/ pho lha mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal sogs kyis sbyin bdag gi gtso bo mdzad de lo de rang du gzim shag dang / khang bu bdun cu lhag tsam 'grub/ brgya lhag tsam gyi rtsig gdan bting / phyi lor rje rin po che dbu bzhugs rab gnas gzhi rgya chen po gnang / dgon pa'i mtshan la 'brog ri bo dga' ldan zhes gsol don ni sku skye phyi ma dga' ldan du 'khrungs rgyu yin pas dgon mtshan du'ang dga' ldan zhes gsol/ 'brog ri bo zhes pa ni sa der 'brog sa zhes 'bod cing shar ngos kyi sde tsho chung ngu der deng sang yang sa ma 'brog ces zer/ gzhan yang dgon de'i 'byung ba 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang /mdo sde za ma tog sogs gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / ma cig lab sgron/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan sogs kyi lung bstan du'ang gsal bas rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i dgon gnas yin zhes gsungs/ de ltar dgon de'i tshogs chen 'du khang du dge 'dun sum stong lhag shong zhing / gtsang khang spug — mar dga' ldan gser khri zhes rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri/ gser zangs las grub pa'i rje tsong kha pa dang / rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan/ gsung rten du 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag ces gser las bris pa'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ yang stong du gser zangs kyi rgya phibs/ yangs pa can du rje tsong kha pa'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung khang / phyis su dga' ldan khri thog lnga bcu pa bya bral dge 'dun phun tshogs kyis gser sbyangs kyis btums pas gser gdung zhes par bsgyur/ gser gdung gi g.yas g.yon du rgyal tshab

rje'i phyag mdzub kyis bton gnang ba'i bdud rtsi chu mig dang / nyag ra la steng du 'brug pa kun legs kyi rang byon/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi rang byon/chos rgyal gyi rang byon/ 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i rang byon/ nag po skor gsum gyi rang byon/ rdo spungs yod sar spyan ras gzigs kha sam ṇi'i rang byon/ de nas rim bzhin je tsong kha pa'i phyag phreng gi rang byon dang dom ra'i rang byon/ dbu zhwa'i rang byon/ chos gos kyi rang byon/ dpal ldan lha mo'i chibs pa'i zhabs rjes/ mkhas grub rjes phyag sen gyis bris gnang ba'i gang nyid kyi sku brnyan dang de'i zhogs su rje rin po ches spyan gyis ma gzigs par phyag phyir brkyangs gnang nas bris gnang ba'i nyid kyi sku brnyan/ byang sham bha la'i rta 'dogs sa/ rig pa spyi blugs kyi rang byon/ ni'u li'i rang byon/ ba zhabs kyu bu zhes pa'i rang byon/ brag gad po bar do'i phrang zhes pa/lam ltag tu ma ṇi'i rang byon/ lam 'og tu dur khrod/ dung dkar gter las bzhes pa'i rang byon/ gzhan yang de khul du 'gog pa ri zhes zer/'gog pa ri zhes pa ni sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung dus dge slong zhig ri de'i bragagaseb tu 'gog snyoms la bzhugs yod pa la dgon pa rgyag skabs sa rdo brko slog byas stabs snyoms 'jug las bzhengs te rgyal ba 'od srung gang du bzhugs yod dam zhes gsungs par/ da lta rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa yin zhes zhus/ de nas rdzu 'phrul du ma bstan te mya ngan las 'das pas rjes su ri de la 'gog pa ri zhes thogs/ de nas sangs rgyas 'od srung gi 'phel gdung phebs pa'i rang byon der nya stong brgyad gsum la ri dwags kyis kyang skor ba rgyag srol yod zer/ de nas rje tsong kha pa zhabs skor du phebs skabs khu brug gi skad gsan pas rje tsong kha pa yum dran te a ma zhes gsung shor bas brag ldebs nas a zhes sgra dang bcas a yig gi rang byon thon pa/ de nas bzung dga' ldan gling nang du khu byug gi skad sgrog srol med zer/ de nas
